title.zh: 卷13 本紀十三 高宗本紀四
title.raw: 卷13 本紀十三 高宗本紀四

sentences.zh: 三十一年春正月壬申朔，詔以御宇三十年，函夏謐寧，寰宇式辟，自本年始，普免各省漕糧一次。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, spring, first month, new moon on day renshen: an edict stated that in thirty years of ruling the realm, all within the Four Seas was tranquil and secure and the universe had been brought to order; from this year onward, grain-transport taxes were universally remitted once in every province.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Qianlong 31, on the first-month new moon, Hongli ordered a one-time canal-tax remission in every province after thirty years on the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，免甘肅靖遠等十四廳州縣、陝西延安等三府州屬積年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for fourteen Gansu departments, prefectures, and counties including Jingyuan, and for subordinate units of three Shaanxi prefectures and departments including Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, fourteen Gansu and three Shaanxi districts were forgiven back taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，雲南官軍剿莽匪於猛住，失利。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Yunnan government troops suppressed Mang bandits at Mengzhu and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Yunnan forces lost a fight with Mang bandits at Mengzhu.

sentences.zh: 調楊應琚為雲貴總督，吳達善為陝甘總督，以和其衷護之。

translations.literal: Yang Yingqi was transferred to be Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Wu Dashan to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general; He Hezhong was assigned as protector.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingqi took Yunnan-Guizhou; Wu Dashan, Shaanxi-Gansu; He Hezhong became protector.

sentences.zh: 調劉藻為湖廣總督，湯聘署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Liu Zao was transferred to be Huguang governor-general; Tang Pin was made acting Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zao took Huguang; Tang Pin acted as Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，刑部尚書庄有恭以讞段成功劾案不實，褫職下獄，籍產。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Minister of Punishments Zhuang Yougong, because his judgment in the impeachment case of Duan Chenggong was not factual, was stripped of office, imprisoned, and his property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhuang Yougong, minister of punishments, lost his post and property for a false verdict in Duan Chenggong's impeachment.

sentences.zh: 調李侍堯為刑部尚書，以張泰開為禮部尚書，范時綬為左都御史。

translations.literal: Li Shiyao was transferred to be Minister of Punishments; Zhang Taikai was made Minister of Rites; Fan Shishou was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiyao took punishments; Zhang Taikai, rites; Fan Shishou, left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，劉藻降湖北巡撫，仍與雲南提督達啟下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Second month, day renyin: Liu Zao was demoted to Hubei governor; he was still ordered to join Yunnan Military Governor Da Qi and his subordinates in strict deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, renyin, Liu Zao became Hubei governor but still faced joint inquiry with Yunnan commander Da Qi.

sentences.zh: 以定長為湖廣總督，調李因培為福建巡撫，常鈞為湖南巡撫，湯聘為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Ding Chang was made Huguang governor-general; Li Yinpei was transferred to Fujian governor; Chang Jun to Hunan governor; Tang Pin to Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Chang took Huguang; Li Yinpei, Fujian; Chang Jun, Hunan; Tang Pin, Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor paid rites at the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Hongli worshipped at the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，和其衷以彌補段成功虧空，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, He Hezhong, for covering Duan Chenggong's deficit, was stripped of office and arrested for questioning.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, He Hezhong was arrested for masking Duan Chenggong's losses.

sentences.zh: 以舒赫德署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Shuhede was made acting Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 命四達赴陝西會彰寶審辦段成功虧空一案。

translations.literal: Sida was ordered to go to Shaanxi to join Zhang Bao in investigating and handling the case of Duan Chenggong's deficit.
translations.idiomatic: Sida was sent to Shaanxi to try Duan Chenggong's deficit case with Zhang Bao.

sentences.zh: 調明山為陝西巡撫，以吳紹詩為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Mingshan was transferred to be Shaanxi governor; Wu Shaoshi was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Mingshan took Shaanxi; Wu Shaoshi, Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，庄有恭論斬。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Zhuang Yougong was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhuang Yougong was condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor paid rites at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Hongli worshipped at Tailing.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，劉藻褫職，留滇效力。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Liu Zao was stripped of office and ordered to remain in Yunnan to serve effectively.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Liu Zao lost rank but stayed in Yunnan on duty.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以鄂寧為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, E Ning was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, E Ning became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，劉藻畏罪自殺。

translations.literal: Third month, day dinghai: Liu Zao, fearing punishment, committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, dinghai, Liu Zao killed himself in fear of trial.

sentences.zh: 己丑，楊應琚以復猛籠等土司內附奏聞。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Yang Yingqi memorialized that the tusi of Menglong and others had returned and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Yang Yingqi reported Menglong tusi submitting again.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，楊應琚奏大猛養頭人內附，官軍進取整欠、孟艮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: Yang Yingqi memorialized that the chief of Damengyang had submitted; government troops advanced to take Zhengqian and Menggen.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, xinchou, Yang Yingqi reported Damengyang's chief submitting; troops moved on Zhengqian and Menggen.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以莽匪整欠平，宣諭中外。

translations.literal: On day renyin, because the Mang bandit Zhengqian had been pacified, proclamation was made to the inner and outer realms.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, with Zhengqian crushed, the court announced victory at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 丙午，和其衷論斬，段成功處斬。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, He Hezhong was sentenced to decapitation; Duan Chenggong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, He Hezhong was condemned to death and Duan Chenggong was executed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免雲南普藤等十三土司本年額賦及猛籠逋賦。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, quota taxes for this year and accumulated taxes at Menglong were remitted for thirteen Yunnan tusi including Puteng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, thirteen Yunnan tusi including Puteng were tax-exempt for the year and for Menglong arrears.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賜張書勛等二百一十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Zhang Shuxun and two hundred thirteen others were granted jinshi degrees with graded ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, two hundred thirteen graduates including Zhang Shuxun received jinshi ranks.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiaxu: the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, jiaxu, Hongli prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命正一真人視三品秩。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Perfect Man of the Orthodox Unity was ordered to hold third-rank standing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Zhengyi celestial master was granted third rank.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Hongli again prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，楊應琚奏猛勇頭目召齋及猛龍沙頭目叭護猛等內附。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu: Yang Yingqi memorialized that the chief Zhaozhai of Mengyong and the chiefs Bahumeng of Menglongsha and others had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, bingwu, Yang Yingqi reported Mengyong and Menglongsha chiefs submitting.

sentences.zh: 戊申，予故三品銜西洋人郎世寧侍郎銜。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the deceased Westerner Lang Shining, formerly of third rank, was posthumously granted vice-minister rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the late Jesuit painter Lang Shining received posthumous vice-minister rank.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingzi: the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, bingzi, Hongli and the Empress Dowager left for the Mulan autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以阿里袞、于敏中扈從，命舒赫德兼署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Arigun and Yu Minzhong were ordered to accompany; Shuhede was ordered to serve additionally as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Arigun and Yu Minzhong joined the hunt; Shuhede also took revenue.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上奉皇太后駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, lodged at the Mountain Resort for Escaping the Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Hongli and the Empress Dowager reached the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 是日，皇后崩。

translations.literal: On that day, the Empress died.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, the Empress died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，諭以皇后上年從幸江、浙，不能恪盡孝道，喪儀照皇貴妃例。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, an edict stated that because last year the Empress had accompanied the tour to Jiangsu and Zhejiang but could not fulfill filial duty with full devotion, funeral rites would follow the precedent for an imperial noble consort.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Hongli ruled the Empress would be buried as an imperial noble consort for failing filial duties on the Jiang-Zhe tour.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，御史李玉鳴奏皇后喪儀未能如例，忤旨，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Censor Li Yuming memorialized that the Empress's funeral rites could not match precedent; displeasing the throne, he was banished to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Li Yuming was exiled to Yili for protesting the Empress's reduced funeral.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，楊應琚奏補哈大頭目噶第牙翁、猛撒頭目喇鮓細利內附。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Yang Yingqi memorialized that the chief Gadiyaweng of Buhada and the chief Lazhaxili of Mengsa had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Yang Yingqi reported Buhada and Mengsa chiefs submitting.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，賑湖南湘陰等十三縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jihai: flood relief was given for water disaster in thirteen Hunan counties and guards including Xiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jihai, thirteen Hunan flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor went to Mulan for the hunt enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Hongli hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 宥庄有恭罪，起為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhuang Yougong's crime was pardoned; he was raised to be Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang Yougong was pardoned and made Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，伊犁蝗。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, locusts struck Yili.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, locusts swarmed Yili.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，江蘇銅山縣韓家堂河決。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Hanjiatang River breached at Tongshan county, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Hanjiatang dike broke at Tongshan, Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，裁察哈爾副都統，留一員駐張家口。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Chahar deputy commandants were reduced; one post was retained stationed at Zhangjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Chahar deputy commands were cut to one man at Zhangjiakou.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，免甘肅靖遠等九縣，紅水、東樂二縣被旱額賦。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: quota taxes were remitted for drought in nine Gansu counties including Jingyuan and for two counties, Hongshui and Dongle.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, renshen, eleven Gansu drought counties were tax-exempt.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賑山東歷城等五十五縣、東昌等五衛所水災，並蠲新舊額賦。

translations.literal: On day jimao, flood relief was given for water disaster in fifty-five Shandong counties including Licheng and five guards and posts including Dongchang, and both new and old quota taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, sixty Shandong flood districts were relieved and lost new and old taxes.

sentences.zh: 乙未，楊應琚赴永昌受木邦降。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Yang Yingqi went to Yongchang to receive the surrender of Mubang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Yang Yingqi took Mubang's surrender at Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jihai: the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, jihai, Hongli and the Empress Dowager returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊申，楊應琚奏整賣、景線、景海各部頭人內附。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Yang Yingqi memorialized that the chiefs of Zhengmai, Jingxian, Jinghai, and other departments had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yang Yingqi reported chiefs of Zhengmai, Jingxian, and Jinghai submitting.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，韓家堂決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Hanjiatang breach was closed and united.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Hanjiatang break was sealed.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書彭啟豐降補侍郎。

translations.literal: Minister of War Peng Qifeng was demoted to supplementary vice-minister.
translations.idiomatic: War minister Peng Qifeng was demoted to vice-minister.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以陸宗楷為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Lu Zongkai was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Lu Zongkai became war minister.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，增設雲南迤南道。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Yunnan Yinan circuit was added.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yunnan gained a new Yinan circuit.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，楊應琚奏，緬甸大山、猛育、猛答各部頭人內附。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yihai: Yang Yingqi memorialized that the chiefs of Burma's Dashan, Mengyu, Mengda, and other departments had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, yihai, Yang Yingqi reported Burmese chiefs of Dashan, Mengyu, and Mengda submitting.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以楊應琚病，命楊廷璋赴永昌接辦緬匪。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, because Yang Yingqi was ill, Yang Tingzhang was ordered to go to Yongchang to take over handling the Burmese bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, ill Yang Yingqi was relieved by Yang Tingzhang at Yongchang for the Burma campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命侍衛福靈安帶御醫往視楊應琚病。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Bodyguard Fuling'an was ordered to bring an imperial physician to visit Yang Yingqi's illness.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Fuling'an was sent with a court doctor to see Yang Yingqi.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，調鄂寧為湖南巡撫，以鄂寶為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi: E Ning was transferred to be Hunan governor; E Bao was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, yisi, E Ning took Hunan; E Bao, Hubei.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以巴祿為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Balu was made Suiyuan city general.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Balu became Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十二年春正月乙亥，雲南官軍剿緬匪於新街，失利，諭楊廷璋回廣東。

translations.literal: Thirty-second year, spring, first month, day yihai: Yunnan government troops suppressed Burmese bandits at Xinjie and suffered defeat; Yang Tingzhang was ordered to return to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Qianlong 32, yihai, Yunnan forces lost at Xinjie; Yang Tingzhang was recalled to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，以楊應琚病，命其子江蘇按察使楊重英赴永昌襄理軍務。

translations.literal: Second month, day yimao: because Yang Yingqi was ill, his son Yang Chongying, Jiangsu surveillance commissioner, was ordered to go to Yongchang to assist in managing military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, yimao, Yang Yingqi's son Chongying, Jiangsu commissioner, was sent to Yongchang to run the war.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雲南官軍與緬匪戰於底麻江，失利，逮提督李時升下獄。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Yunnan government troops fought Burmese bandits on the Dima River and suffered defeat; Military Governor Li Shisheng was arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yunnan lost on the Dima River; commander Li Shisheng was jailed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，調鄂寧為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wushen, E Ning was transferred to be Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, E Ning became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，庄親王允祿卒。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Prince Zhuang Yunlu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Prince Zhuang Yunlu died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上臨奠。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor went in person to offer mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Hongli mourned him in person.

sentences.zh: 己未，上巡幸天津。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor went on tour to Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Hongli toured Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賑奉天承德等五州縣及興京鳳凰城災民。

translations.literal: On day guihai, disaster victims were relieved in five Fengtian prefectures and counties including Chengde and in Xingjing Fenghuang city.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, six Fengtian disaster districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑朔，上閱子牙河堤。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day yichou: the Emperor inspected the Ziya River dike.
translations.idiomatic: On the third-month new moon, Hongli inspected the Ziya River dike.

sentences.zh: 召楊應琚入閣辦事，以明瑞為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Yang Yingqi was summoned to attend affairs in the Grand Council; Ming Rui was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingqi joined the Grand Council; Ming Rui became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，調託庸為工部尚書，以明瑞為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Tuoyong was transferred to be Minister of Works; Ming Rui was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Tuoyong took works; Ming Rui, war.

sentences.zh: 己巳，免直隸全省逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jisi, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for all of Zhili province.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, all Zhili back taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上閱天津駐防滿洲兵。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor reviewed the garrison Manchu troops at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Hongli reviewed Tianjin's Manchu garrison.

sentences.zh: 以阿桂為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Agui was made Yili general.
translations.idiomatic: Agui became Yili general.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上閱綠營兵。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor reviewed the Green Standard troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Hongli reviewed the Green Standard army.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大學士楊應琚褫職。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Grand Secretary Yang Yingqi was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Yang Yingqi lost his grand secretary post.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以緬匪入寇盞達、隴川，宣示楊應琚貽誤罪狀。

translations.literal: On day renwu, because Burmese bandits had invaded Zhandian and Longchuan, Yang Yingqi's crimes of causing delay and harm were proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Burma's raid on Zhandian and Longchuan exposed Yang Yingqi's blunders.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命鄂寧赴普洱辦軍務。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, E Ning was ordered to go to Pu'er to manage military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, E Ning was sent to Pu'er for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以李侍堯為兩廣總督，召楊廷璋為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Li Shiyao was made Liangguang governor-general; Yang Tingzhang was recalled to be Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Li Shiyao took Liangguang; Yang Tingzhang became punishments minister.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以鄂寧署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: On day guisi, E Ning was made acting Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, E Ning acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiyou: the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, jiyou, Hongli prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以雲南邊境瘴盛，命暫停進兵。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, because miasma was severe on the Yunnan border, advance of troops was ordered temporarily halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Yunnan's border miasma halted the advance.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命張泰開以禮部尚書管左都御史事，嵇璜署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Zhang Taikai was ordered to serve as Minister of Rites while managing affairs of the Left Censorate; Ji Huang was made acting Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Zhang Taikai took rites and the censorate; Ji Huang acted as rites minister.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，以鄂寶為貴州巡撫，定長兼署湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi: E Bao was made Guizhou governor; Ding Chang was ordered to serve additionally as Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, jisi, E Bao took Guizhou; Ding Chang also acted as Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以范時綬為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Fan Shishou was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Fan Shishou became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 調張泰開為左都御史，嵇璜為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Zhang Taikai was transferred to be Left Censor-in-Chief; Ji Huang was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Taikai took the censorate; Ji Huang, rites.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命陳宏謀管工部。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Chen Hongmou was ordered to manage the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Chen Hongmou took charge of works.

sentences.zh: 丙子，雲南官軍失利於木邦，楊寧等退師龍陵。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Yunnan government troops suffered defeat at Mubang; Yang Ning and others withdrew troops to Longling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Yunnan lost at Mubang; Yang Ning retreated to Longling.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，李時升、朱侖處斬。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Li Shisheng and Zhu Lun were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Li Shisheng and Zhu Lun were put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，以額爾景額為參贊大臣，遣赴雲南。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou: Erjing'e was made campaign participation minister and dispatched to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, xinyou, Erjing'e was sent to Yunnan as campaign commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，福建巡撫庄有恭卒，調崔應階代之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Fujian governor Zhuang Yougong died; Cui Yingjie was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, Zhuang Yougong died; Cui Yingjie took Fujian.

sentences.zh: 以李清時為山東巡撫，裘曰修為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Li Qingshi was made Shandong governor; Qiu Yuexiu was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qingshi took Shandong; Qiu Yuexiu, rites.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Hongli and the Empress Dowager left for the Mulan autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, lodged at the Mountain Resort for Escaping the Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Hongli and the Empress Dowager reached the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 己丑，盛京將軍舍圖肯免，以新柱代之。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Mukden General Shetuken was dismissed; Xinzhu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Shetuken left Mukden; Xinzhu took the post.

sentences.zh: 閏七月甲寅，賜楊應琚自盡。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day jiayin: Yang Yingqi was granted permission to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary seventh-month jiayin, Yang Yingqi was ordered to commit suicide.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，緬匪渡小猛侖江入寇雲南茨通。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Burmese bandits crossed the Xiaomenglun River and invaded Citong in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Burmese raiders crossed the Xiaomenglun and struck Yunnan's Citong.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，調裘曰修為工部尚書，董邦達為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiyou: Qiu Yuexiu was transferred to be Minister of Works; Dong Bangda was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, guiyou, Qiu Yuexiu took works; Dong Bangda, rites.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor went to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Hongli went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以鍾音為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Zhong Yin was made Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhong Yin became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，諭明瑞以額勒登額代譚五格分路進兵。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Ming Rui was instructed that Eledeng'e would replace Tan Wuge for advancing troops by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Ming Rui was told Eledeng'e would replace Tan Wuge on a separate route.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，賑湖北江夏等二十七縣、武昌等七衛水災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengzi: relief was given for flood disaster in twenty-seven Hubei counties including Jiangxia and seven guards including Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, gengzi, twenty-seven Hubei counties and seven guards received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命託恩多署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Toenduo was ordered to act as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Toenduo acted as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，賜李因培自盡。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renxu: Li Yinpei was granted permission to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, renxu, Li Yinpei was ordered to commit suicide.

sentences.zh: 己卯，諭明瑞以將軍管總督。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Ming Rui was instructed to combine general and governor-general duties.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Ming Rui was told to hold both general and governor-general posts.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，賑甘肅平涼等三十四廳州縣被雹災民。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renyin: relief was given to the people of thirty-four Gansu prefectures, departments, and counties including Pingliang for hail disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, renyin, thirty-four Gansu hail districts including Pingliang were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬子，調鄂寶為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renzi, E Bao was transferred to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, E Bao became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，密諭明瑞，以阿瓦不能遽下，退師木邦。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, a secret edict instructed Ming Rui that Ava could not be taken quickly and to withdraw the army to Mubang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Ming Rui was secretly told Ava would not fall soon and to pull back to Mubang.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，楊寧褫職戍伊犁。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu: Yang Ning was stripped of office and banished to serve at Yili.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiaxu, Yang Ning lost his post and was exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，明瑞奏渡大疊江進軍錫箔，波龍等處土司頭人羅外耀特等內附。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Ming Rui memorialized crossing the Dadies River and advancing on Xibo; the tusi headmen Luo Waiyao and others of Bolong and elsewhere came over.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Ming Rui crossed the Dadies and marched on Xibo; Bolong chiefs including Luo Waiyao submitted.

sentences.zh: 三十三年春正月辛卯，明瑞奏克蠻結。

translations.literal: Thirty-third year, spring, first month, day xinmao: Ming Rui memorialized the capture of Manjie.
translations.idiomatic: In year 33, month 1, xinmao, Ming Rui reported Manjie taken.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，封明瑞一等誠毅嘉勇公，賜黃帶、紅寶石頂、四團龍補服。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Ming Rui was enfeoffed as first-rank Duke of Sincere Valor and Courageous Merit, and granted yellow belt, ruby finial, and four-round-dragon rank robe.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Ming Rui became Duke of Sincere Valor and Courageous Merit with yellow belt, ruby finial, and four-dragon robe.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，明瑞進軍宋賽。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Ming Rui advanced the army to Song Sai.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Ming Rui marched on Song Sai.

sentences.zh: 庚子，調彰寶為山東巡撫，以蘇爾德為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Zhang Bao was transferred to Shandong governor; Su Erde was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhang Bao took Shandong; Su Erde, Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，盛京將軍新柱卒，調明福代之。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Mukden general Xinzhu died; Ming Fu was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Xinzhu died; Ming Fu became Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 閩浙總督蘇昌卒。

translations.literal: Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general Su Chang died.
translations.idiomatic: Su Chang, Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, died.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命阿里袞為參贊大臣，往雲南軍營。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Arigun was ordered to serve as campaigning assistant commissioner and go to the Yunnan army camp.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Arigun was sent as expedition adviser to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 以崔應階為閩浙總督，富尼漢為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Cui Yingjie was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Funihan Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yingjie took Fujian-Zhejiang; Funihan, Fujian.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，緬人圍木邦。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Burmese besieged Mubang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Burmese forces besieged Mubang.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，諭用兵緬甸，輕敵致衄，引為己過，令明瑞等班師。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingyin: an edict on the Burma campaign blamed underestimating the enemy for setbacks, took the fault on himself, and ordered Ming Rui and others to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, bingyin, Hongli blamed himself for underestimating Burma and ordered Ming Rui to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 額勒登額、譚五格褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Eledeng'e and Tan Wuge were stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Eledeng'e and Tan Wuge were dismissed and arrested.

sentences.zh: 命鄂寧回雲南，阿里袞署雲貴總督，駐永昌。

translations.literal: E Ning was ordered back to Yunnan; Arigun acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general, stationed at Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: E Ning returned to Yunnan; Arigun acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor at Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 緬人陷木邦，珠魯訥死之。

translations.literal: The Burmese took Mubang; Zhulune died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Burmese forces took Mubang; Zhulune was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上還圓明園。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Hongli returned to Yuanmingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，明瑞等敗績於猛育，死之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Ming Rui and others were defeated at Mengyu and died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Ming Rui's force was defeated at Mengyu; he died.

sentences.zh: 召阿桂來京，以伊勒圖署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Agui was summoned to the capital; Yiletuo acted as Yili general.
translations.idiomatic: Agui was recalled to Beijing; Yiletuo acted as Yili general.

sentences.zh: 命傅恆為經略，阿里袞、阿桂為副將軍，舒赫德為參贊大臣，赴雲南。

translations.literal: Fu Heng was ordered as campaign commander-in-chief; Arigun and Agui as deputy generals; Suhede as assistant commissioner—all to go to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng became commander-in-chief; Arigun and Agui, deputy generals; Suhede, adviser—all for Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 以鄂寧為雲貴總督，調明德為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: E Ning was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Mingde was transferred to Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: E Ning became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Mingde, Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 以福隆安為兵部尚書，命在軍機處學習行走。

translations.literal: Fu Long'an was made Minister of War and ordered to study and serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Long'an became Minister of War and joined the Grand Council as trainee.

sentences.zh: 以永德為浙江巡撫，調彰寶為江蘇巡撫，富尼漢為山東巡撫，鄂寶為福建巡撫，程燾為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Yongde was made Zhejiang governor; Zhang Bao transferred to Jiangsu governor; Funihan Shandong governor; E Bao Fujian governor; Cheng Tao Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yongde took Zhejiang; Zhang Bao, Jiangsu; Funihan, Shandong; E Bao, Fujian; Cheng Tao, Hubei.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，免山東高苑等三縣三十二年被水額賦。

translations.literal: Third month, day guisi: quota taxes were remitted for the thirty-second year of flood in three Shandong counties including Gaoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, guisi, three Shandong flood counties including Gaoyuan lost year-32 taxes.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，調鄂寶為廣西巡撫，鍾音為福建巡撫，良卿為廣東巡撫，錢度為貴州巡撫，巴祿為察哈爾都統，傅良為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day yisi, E Bao was transferred to Guangxi governor; Zhong Yin Fujian governor; Liangqing Guangdong governor; Qian Du Guizhou governor; Balu Chahar commander; Fu Liang Suiyuan general.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, E Bao took Guangxi; Zhong Yin, Fujian; Liangqing, Guangdong; Qian Du, Guizhou; Balu, Chahar; Fu Liang, Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免江西南昌等十三縣三十二年被水額賦。

translations.literal: On day guichou, quota taxes were remitted for the thirty-second year of flood in thirteen Jiangxi counties including Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, thirteen Jiangxi flood counties lost year-32 taxes.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，調錢度為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingmao: Qian Du was transferred to Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, dingmao, Qian Du became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，免安徽安慶等七府州屬三十二年被水額賦。

translations.literal: On day jisi, quota taxes were remitted for the thirty-second year of flood in seven Anhui prefectures and departments including Anqing and their subordinate districts.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, seven Anhui flood prefectures lost year-32 taxes.

sentences.zh: 壬申，御試翰林、詹事等官，擢吳省欽等三員為一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor held the palace examination for Hanlin Academy, Household Administration of the Heir Apparent, and other officials; Wu Shengqin and two others were promoted first class; the rest promoted or demoted variously.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Hongli examined Hanlin and related officials; Wu Shengqin and two others took first place.

sentences.zh: 試由部院入翰林等官，擢覺羅巴彥學為一等，餘升擢有差。

translations.literal: Officials entering the Hanlin from boards and courts were examined; Jueluo Bayanxue was promoted first class; the rest promoted variously.
translations.idiomatic: Board entrants to the Hanlin were examined; Jueluo Bayanxue took first place.

sentences.zh: 甲申，磔額勒登額於市，譚五格處斬。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Eledeng'e was dismembered at the market; Tan Wuge was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Eledeng'e was executed by lingchi; Tan Wuge beheaded.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上臨奠明瑞、紥拉豐阿、觀音保。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor went in person to offer mourning for Ming Rui, Zhala Feng'a, and Guanyinbao.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Hongli mourned Ming Rui, Zhala Feng'a, and Guanyinbao.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，命明德赴永昌。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengshen: Mingde was ordered to go to Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, gengshen, Mingde was sent to Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，色布騰巴勒珠爾病免，以伊勒圖為理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Sebten Balzhur was excused on grounds of illness; Yiletuo was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, sick Sebten Balzhur left office; Yiletuo became colonial affairs minister.

sentences.zh: 庚午，改命官保署理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Guanbao was instead ordered to act as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Guanbao acted as colonial affairs minister instead.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以范時綬為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Fan Shishou was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Fan Shishou became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以阿桂為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Agui was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Agui became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 尹繼善、高晉以兩淮鹽務積弊匿不以聞，均下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Yin Jishan and Gao Jin, for concealing long-standing abuses in the Lianghuai salt administration and not reporting them, were both referred to the ministry for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jishan and Gao Jin faced severe ministry review for hiding Lianghuai salt abuses.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, guisi, Hongli and the Empress Dowager left for the Mulan autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 甲午，調託庸為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Tuoyong was transferred to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Tuoyong became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 以官保為刑部尚書，仍兼署理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Guanbao was made Minister of Punishments and still concurrently acted as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guanbao became Punishments minister and still acted at colonial affairs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, lodged at the Mountain Resort for Escaping the Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Hongli and the Empress Dowager stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以尹勒圖為伊犁將軍，仍兼理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Yinletu was made Yili general, still concurrently Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Yinletu became Yili general and still held colonial affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，紀昀以漏泄籍沒前運使盧見曾諭旨，褫職，戍烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Ji Yun, for leaking the secret edict on former transport commissioner Lu Jianzeng's confiscation, was stripped of office and banished to Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Ji Yun was dismissed and exiled to Urumqi for leaking Lu Jianzeng's confiscation edict.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，允俄羅斯於恰克圖通商。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingmao: Russia was permitted to trade at Kiakhta.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, dingmao, Russia was allowed trade at Kiakhta.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor went to Mulan for the hunt enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Hongli hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，直隸總督方觀承卒，以楊廷璋代之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Zhili governor-general Fang Guancheng died; Yang Tingzhang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Fang Guancheng died; Yang Tingzhang became Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 調裘曰修為刑部尚書，以蔡新為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Qiu Yixiu was transferred to Minister of Punishments; Cai Xin was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Yixiu took Punishments; Cai Xin, Works.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，李侍堯奏，暹羅為緬人所破，其國王之孫詔萃奔安南河仙鎮，土官莫士麟留養之，內地人甘恩敕據暹羅，乞封敕。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Li Shiyao memorialized that Siam had been broken by the Burmese; the king's grandson Zhao Cui fled to Ha Tien in Annam, where native official Mo Shilin sheltered him; the mainland man Gan Endi held Siam and begged to be enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Li Shiyao reported Burma had broken Siam; the royal grandson Zhao Cui fled to Ha Tien; Gan Endi seized Siam and sought a title.

sentences.zh: 嘉獎莫士麟，命甘恩敕求其主近支立之，不得自王乞封號。

translations.literal: Mo Shilin was commended; Gan Endi was ordered to find a near collateral of the former ruler to install and not seek a kingship for himself.
translations.idiomatic: Mo Shilin was praised; Gan Endi was told to restore a legitimate Siam ruler, not crown himself.

sentences.zh: 己卯，加託恩多、于敏中、崔應階太子太保，託庸、楊廷璋太子少保。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Toenduo, Yu Minzhong, and Cui Yingjie were promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Tuoyong and Yang Tingzhang to Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, three became grand guardians of the heir; Tuoyong and Yang Tingzhang, junior guardians.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，以嵩椿署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi: Songchun acted as Yili general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, wuzi, Songchun acted as Yili general.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor returned to lodge at the Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Hongli returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，高恆、普福論斬。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Gao Heng and Pufu were sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Gao Heng and Pufu were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Hongli and the Empress Dowager returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以鄂寶為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: E Bao was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: E Bao became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江將軍富僧阿改西安將軍，以傅玉代之。

translations.literal: Heilongjiang general Fuseng'a was transferred to Xi'an general; Fu Yu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Fuseng'a moved from Heilongjiang to Xi'an; Fu Yu took Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，免甘肅平涼等十二州縣三十二年被災額賦。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiwei: quota taxes were remitted for the thirty-second year of disaster in twelve Gansu prefectures and counties including Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, jiwei, twelve Gansu disaster districts including Pingliang lost year-32 taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以宮兆麟為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Gong Zhaolin was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Gong Zhaolin became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，高恆、普福、達色處斬，改海明等緩決。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Gao Heng, Pufu, and Dase were executed; Haiming and others were changed to suspended sentences.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Gao Heng, Pufu, and Dase were executed; Haiming's party got reprieves.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，以緬人來書不遜，諭阿里袞籌進剿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuxu: because the Burmese letter was disrespectful, Arigun was instructed to plan an advance and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, wuxu, a rude Burmese letter sent Arigun to plan a new campaign.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，以富明安為山東巡撫，揆義署湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei: Fu Ming'an was made Shandong governor; Kuaiyi acted as Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiwei, Fu Ming'an took Shandong; Kuaiyi acted at Hubei.

sentences.zh: 漕運總督楊錫紱卒，以梁翥鴻署之。

translations.literal: Canal Transport Governor-General Yang Xizhen died; Liang Zhuhong acted in the post.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xizhen died; Liang Zhuhong acted as canal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，湖廣總督定長卒，調吳達善代之，彰寶兼署兩江總督，明山為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Huguang governor-general Ding Chang died; Wu Dashan was transferred to replace him; Zhang Bao concurrently acted as Liangjiang governor-general; Mingshan was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Ding Chang died; Wu Dashan took Huguang; Zhang Bao acted at Liangjiang; Mingshan, Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 調阿思哈為陝西巡撫，以文綬為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Asiha was transferred to Shaanxi governor; Wen Shou was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Asiha took Shaanxi; Wen Shou, Henan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召明福來京，以額爾德蒙額署盛京將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Ming Fu was summoned to the capital; Erdeni Meng'e acted as Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Ming Fu was recalled; Erdeni Meng'e acted as Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賑奉天承德等四州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, relief was given for flood disaster in four Fengtian prefectures and counties including Chengde.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, four Fengtian flood districts including Chengde were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬午，留阿思哈為河南巡撫，改文綬為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Asiha was kept as Henan governor; Wen Shou was changed to Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Asiha stayed at Henan; Wen Shou moved to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 三十四年春正月丙戌，免雲南官兵所過地方及永昌等三府州本年額賦。

translations.literal: Thirty-fourth year, spring, first month, day bingxu: quota taxes were remitted for this year in places passed through by Yunnan troops and three prefectures and departments including Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 34, month 1, bingxu, Yunnan march routes and three Yongchang-area prefectures lost this year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 其非經過地方，免十分之五，並免湖北、湖南、貴州三省官兵經過地方本年額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: Where troops did not pass, five-tenths were remitted; in Hubei, Hunan, and Guizhou places troops passed through, three-tenths of this year's quota taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Non-route districts lost half their taxes; Hubei, Hunan, and Guizhou march routes lost three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以緬人書詞桀驁，命副將軍阿桂與副將軍阿里袞協助傅恆征剿。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, because the Burmese letter was arrogant, Deputy General Agui and Deputy General Arigun were ordered to assist Fu Heng in the punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an arrogant Burmese letter put Agui and Arigun under Fu Heng for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命明德為雲貴總督，駐永昌，喀寧阿為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Mingde was ordered as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general, stationed at Yongchang; Kaning'a Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Mingde became Yunnan-Guizhou governor at Yongchang; Kaning'a, Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，阿里袞等敗緬人於南底壩。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Arigun and others defeated the Burmese at Nandi Dam.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Arigun routed the Burmese at Nandi Dam.

sentences.zh: 撥運通倉米二十萬石賑霸州等十二州縣災。

translations.literal: Two hundred thousand shi of grain from the Tong warehouse were allocated to relieve disaster in twelve prefectures and counties including Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred thousand shi from Tong granary relieved twelve districts including Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，右部哈薩克阿勒比斯子卓勒齊等來朝。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Zholqi and others, sons of Alibis of the Right Wing Kazakh, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Right Wing Kazakh Alibis's sons Zholqi and others paid court.

sentences.zh: 乙未，調恆祿為盛京將軍，傅良為吉林將軍，常在為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Henglu was transferred to Mukden general; Fu Liang Jilin general; Changzai Suiyuan general.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Henglu took Mukden; Fu Liang, Jilin; Changzai, Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，傅恆赴雲南。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Fu Heng went to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Fu Heng left for Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 命官保署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Guanbao was ordered to act as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Guanbao acted as Revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 裁寧夏右翼副都統、吉林拉林副都統。

translations.literal: The Ningxia Right Wing vice commander and Jilin Lalin vice commander posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia Right Wing and Jilin Lalin vice commander posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 命常青署綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Changqing was ordered to act as Suiyuan general.
translations.idiomatic: Changqing acted as Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賜傅恆御用盔甲。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Fu Heng was granted imperial campaign armor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Fu Heng received imperial armor.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命官保協辦大學士，以福隆安署刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Guanbao was ordered to assist as Grand Secretary; Fu Long'an acted as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Guanbao became associate grand secretary; Fu Long'an acted at Punishments.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以南掌國王之弟召翁遣使請兵復仇，諭阿桂等預備由南掌分路進兵。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because the king of Lan Xang's younger brother Zhao Weng sent envoys requesting troops for revenge, Agui and others were instructed to prepare to advance by separate routes through Lan Xang.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Lan Xang's prince Zhao Weng sought aid; Agui was told to prepare a southern route.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅朔，嵇璜緣事降調，以程景伊為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day jiayin: Ji Huang was demoted and transferred over an affair; Cheng Jingyi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the second-month new moon, Ji Huang was demoted; Cheng Jingyi took Works.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以富尼漢為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Funihan was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Funihan became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命傅恆整飭雲南馬政。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Fu Heng was ordered to put Yunnan horse administration in order.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Fu Heng was told to reform Yunnan horse affairs.

sentences.zh: 以諾倫為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Nuolun was made Suiyuan general.
translations.idiomatic: Nuolun became Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，命伊犁將軍伊勒圖往雲南軍營。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiyou: Yili general Yiletuo was ordered to the Yunnan army camp.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, yiyou, Yili general Yiletuo was sent to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命伊爾圖為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Yirtu was ordered as Urga campaigning assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Yirtu became Urga expedition adviser.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，正白旗領侍衛內大臣福祿罷，以阿桂代之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Plain White Banner chief imperial bodyguard minister Fulu was dismissed; Agui replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Fulu left the inner guard; Agui replaced him.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命阿桂署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Agui was ordered to act as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Agui acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁未，右部哈薩克斡里蘇勒統等入覲，命坐賜茶，賚冠服有差。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Orizuletong and others of the Right Wing Kazakh came to audience; they were ordered seated, granted tea, and given graded robes and caps.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Right Wing Kazakh Orizuletong's party was received, seated for tea, and given graded dress.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賑甘肅皋蘭等二十九州縣廳上年災民。

translations.literal: On day wushen, disaster relief was granted to victims of last year's calamity in twenty-nine prefectures, counties, and sub-prefectures in Gansu including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, twenty-nine Gansu districts including Gaolan received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 蠲安徽合肥等十六州縣及廬州等五衛上年額賦。

translations.literal: Registered tax quotas for last year were remitted for sixteen Anhui prefectures and counties including Hefei and five garrisons including Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's taxes were remitted in sixteen Anhui districts and five garrisons.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，以溫福為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiwei: Wen Fu was made Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Wen Fu became Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，傅恆進兵老官屯，阿桂進兵猛密。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Fu Heng advanced troops to Laoguantun and A Gui to Mengmi.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Fu Heng marched on Laoguantun and A Gui on Mengmi.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賜陳初哲等一百五十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Chen Chuzhe and one hundred fifty-one others were granted jinshi with rank and origin in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, one hundred fifty-one new jinshi including Chen Chuzhe received graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，裁江寧副都統一。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jichou: one Jiangning deputy lieutenant-general was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, one Jiangning deputy lieutenant-general post was cut.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰，以阿思哈為雲貴總督，喀寧阿為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingchen: Asheha was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general and Kaning'a Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Asheha took Yunnan-Guizhou and Kaning'a took Henan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，傅恆奏猛拱土司內附。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Fu Heng memorialized that the Menggong native official had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Fu Heng reported Menggong's submission.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，湖北黃梅江堤決，命湖廣總督吳達善、湖北巡撫揆義勘之。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Huangmei river dike in Hubei burst; Governor-General Wu Dashan of Huguang and Hubei Governor Kuiyi were ordered to inspect it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Huangmei dike broke and Wu Dashan and Kuiyi were sent to survey it.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，以明德署雲貴總督，移駐騰越、經理軍務。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dinghai: Mingde was appointed acting Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general, moving headquarters to Tengyue to oversee military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Mingde acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general at Tengyue for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，設伊犁巴彥岱城領隊大臣一。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, one commandant-colonel was established at Bayandai City, Ili.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, one Ili Bayandai commandant-colonel was appointed.

sentences.zh: 傅恆奏猛密土司內附。

translations.literal: Fu Heng memorialized that the Mengmi native official had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng reported Mengmi's submission.

sentences.zh: 甲午，李侍堯奏暹羅仍為甘恩敕所踞。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Li Shiyao memorialized that Siam remained occupied by Kampeng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Li Shiyao reported Siam still held by Kampeng.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禮部尚書董邦達卒。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Minister of Rites Dong Bangda died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Dong Bangda, minister of rites, died.

sentences.zh: 己亥，調陸宗楷為禮部尚書，蔡新為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Lu Zongkai was transferred to Minister of Rites and Cai Xin to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Lu Zongkai took Rites and Cai Xin took War.

sentences.zh: 以吳紹詩為刑部尚書，海明為江西巡撫，梁國治為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Wu Shaoshi was made Minister of Punishments, Haiming Jiangxi governor, and Liang Guozhi Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaoshi took Punishments; Haiming and Liang Guozhi took Jiangxi and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 己酉，李侍堯檄莫士麟會暹羅土目討甘恩敕。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Li Shiyao issued a dispatch ordering Mo Shilin to join Siamese native officials in attacking Kampeng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Li Shiyao ordered Mo Shilin to join Siamese chiefs against Kampeng.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yichou: the Emperor went to the Mulan hunting grounds.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Emperor went to Mulan for the hunt.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以蔡琛自縊獄中，褫福建按察使孫孝愉職，發軍台。

translations.literal: On day jisi, because Cai Chen hanged himself in prison, Fujian Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Sun Xiaoyu was stripped of office and sent to the military penal colony.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Sun Xiaoyu lost his post over Cai Chen's prison suicide and was sent to the penal colony.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，阿桂進抵蠻暮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingxu: A Gui's advance reached Manmu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, A Gui reached Manmu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor returned to lodge at the Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor returned to the Mountain Resort.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上奉皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager returned from tour.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命阿桂、伊勒圖自蠻暮迓傅恆會師。

translations.literal: On day jihai, A Gui and Iletu were ordered to welcome Fu Heng from Manmu for a united army.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, A Gui and Iletu were told to meet Fu Heng from Manmu.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命劉統勛會勘山東運河。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Liu Tongxun was ordered to join in surveying the Shandong Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Liu Tongxun was sent to survey the Shandong canal.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，傅恆奏猛拱土司渾覺率眾來降。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Fu Heng memorialized that Menggong native official Hunjue led his people in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Fu Heng reported Hunjue of Menggong surrendering with his following.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 特賞三眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: He was specially awarded a three-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He received a special three-eyed peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 戊申，傅恆進抵猛養。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Fu Heng's advance reached Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Fu Heng reached Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 阿桂奏克哈坎，渡江。

translations.literal: A Gui memorialized that Hakhan had been taken and the river crossed.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui reported taking Hakhan and crossing the river.

sentences.zh: 命阿桂據新街剿賊。

translations.literal: A Gui was ordered to hold Xinjie and suppress the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui was told to hold Xinjie and fight the rebels.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，命彰寶署雲貴總督，明德署雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yimao: Zhang Bao was appointed acting Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general and Mingde acting Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zhang Bao and Mingde acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general and Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 調永德為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Yongde was transferred to Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yongde became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 起熊學鵬署浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Xiong Xuepeng was restored and appointed acting Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Xuepeng was restored to act as Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 以增海署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Zenghai was appointed acting Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: Zenghai acted as Ili general.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，傅恆奏攻克猛養。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Fu Heng memorialized that Mengyang had been taken.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Fu Heng reported taking Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，梁國治兼署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Liang Guozhi was concurrently appointed acting Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Liang Guozhi also acted as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以阿桂不能克老官屯，奪副將軍，為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, because A Gui could not take Laoguantun, his vice-generalship was removed and he was made military adviser.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, A Gui lost the vice-generalship for failing at Laoguantun and became military adviser.

sentences.zh: 命伊勒圖為副將軍。

translations.literal: Iletu was ordered to be vice-general.
translations.idiomatic: Iletu was made vice-general.

sentences.zh: 調喀寧阿為貴州巡撫，富尼漢為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Kaning'a was transferred to Guizhou governor and Funihan to Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Kaning'a took Guizhou and Funihan took Henan.

sentences.zh: 以胡文伯為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Hu Wenbo was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Wenbo became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，傅恆奏進抵新街。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Fu Heng memorialized that the advance had reached Xinjie.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Fu Heng reported reaching Xinjie.

sentences.zh: 命彰寶駐老官屯。

translations.literal: Zhang Bao was ordered to station at Laoguantun.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bao was stationed at Laoguantun.

sentences.zh: 壬申，調永貴為禮部尚書，託庸為吏部尚書，伊勒圖為兵部尚書，以託庸兼署。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Yonggui was transferred to Minister of Rites, Tuoyong to Minister of Personnel, and Iletu to Minister of War, with Tuoyong acting concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Yonggui, Tuoyong, and Iletu took Rites, Personnel, and War, with Tuoyong acting in both.

sentences.zh: 調吳紹詩為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Wu Shaoshi was transferred to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaoshi took Rites.

sentences.zh: 以裘曰修為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Qiu Yixiu was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Yixiu became minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，副將軍、戶部尚書阿里袞卒於軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou: Vice-General and Minister of Revenue Ali Gun died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Ali Gun, vice-general and minister of revenue, died in the field.

sentences.zh: 命阿桂仍在副將軍上行走，並以尹勒圖為副將軍，烏三泰、長青為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: A Gui was ordered to continue serving above the vice-general rank; Yinletu was made vice-general; Wusantai and Changqing were made military advisers.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui kept above vice-general rank; Yinletu became vice-general and Wusantai and Changqing became advisers.

sentences.zh: 調官保為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Guan Bao was transferred to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Bao took Revenue.

sentences.zh: 以素爾納為刑部尚書，託恩多署左都御史。

translations.literal: Su'erna was made Minister of Punishments and Tuo'enduo acting Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Su'erna took Punishments and Tuo'enduo acted as left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，傅恆等進攻老官屯。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Fu Heng and others assaulted Laoguantun.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Fu Heng's force attacked Laoguantun.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以黃登賢為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Huang Dengxian was made Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Huang Dengxian became transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以緬地煙瘴，官軍損失大半，命班師屯野牛壩，召經略傅恆還，阿桂留辦善後。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, because of malarial miasma in Burma the government army had lost more than half; withdrawal was ordered to camp at Yeniuba, Grand Secretary Fu Heng recalled, and A Gui left to settle aftermath.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Burma's pestilence halved the army; troops withdrew to Yeniuba, Fu Heng was recalled, and A Gui stayed to clean up.

sentences.zh: 己亥，起觀保署左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Guanbao was restored and appointed acting Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Guanbao was restored to act as left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，傅恆等攻老官屯不克。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Fu Heng and others attacked Laoguantun without success.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Fu Heng failed to take Laoguantun.

sentences.zh: 其土官以緬酋猛駮蒲葉書詣軍營乞降。

translations.literal: The local official came to camp with a letter from Burmese chief Meng Bo Boye seeking surrender.
translations.idiomatic: A local chief brought Meng Bo's surrender letter to camp.

sentences.zh: 上命班師。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the army to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，免雲南辦理軍需地方及永昌等三府州明年錢糧十分之五。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: next year's grain taxes were remitted by five-tenths for localities handling military supplies in Yunnan and three prefectures including Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Yunnan supply districts and Yongchang prefectures had taxes cut by half.

sentences.zh: 其直隸、河南、湖北、湖南、貴州等省官兵經過州縣並免十分之三。

translations.literal: For prefectures and counties through which troops passed in Zhili, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Guizhou, and other provinces, three-tenths were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Transit districts in several provinces also had three-tenths remitted.

sentences.zh: 調宮兆麟為湖南巡撫，以德保為廣東巡撫，陳輝祖為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Gong Zhaolin was transferred to Hunan governor, Debao to Guangdong governor, and Chen Huizu to Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Zhaolin, Debao, and Chen Huizu took Hunan, Guangdong, and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，傅恆等奏緬酋猛駮稱臣納貢。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Fu Heng and others memorialized that Burmese chief Meng Bo had declared himself a subject and offered tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Fu Heng reported Meng Bo submitting and offering tribute.

sentences.zh: 諭俟來京時降旨。

translations.literal: An edict said instructions would be issued when he came to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The throne said an edict would follow when he reached Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上以來年奉皇太后謁東陵，巡幸天津，免經過地方及天津府屬乾隆三十五年錢糧十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jisi, because the next year the Emperor would escort the Empress Dowager to the Eastern Tombs and tour Tianjin, three-tenths of Qianlong 35 grain taxes were remitted for transit districts and Tianjin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, tax remission was granted for the coming eastern tombs and Tianjin tour.

sentences.zh: 以阿桂為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: A Gui was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui became minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 三十五年春正月己卯朔，以上六十壽辰，明歲皇太后八十萬壽，詔普蠲各省額徵地丁錢糧一次。

translations.literal: Thirty-fifth year, spring, first month, new moon on day jimao: because the Emperor would reach sixty and next year the Empress Dowager's eightieth birthday, an edict remitted once all registered land and poll taxes in every province.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Qianlong 35, an edict remitted all provincial land and poll taxes for the imperial and dowager birthdays.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以增海為理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Zenghai was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Zenghai became minister of colonial affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁未，授喀爾喀和碩親王成袞紥布世子拉旺多爾濟為固倫額駙。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Lavangdorji, heir of Khalkha Hosho Prince Chenggunjab, was invested as imperial son-in-law of gurun rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Lavangdorji, Khalkha prince's heir, became imperial son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，上奉皇太后謁東陵。

translations.literal: Second month, day yichou: the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor and Empress Dowager visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上奉皇太后迴鑾，駐盤山。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned from the tour and lodged at Panshan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the imperial party returned and stopped at Panshan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以緬酋猛駮貢表不至，諭彰寶備之，並嚴禁通市。

translations.literal: On day renshen, because Burmese chief Meng Bo's tribute memorial had not arrived, Zhang Bao was instructed to prepare and border trade was strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Meng Bo's tribute delay led to warnings to Zhang Bao and a trade ban.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: Third month, day jimao: the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the imperial party returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 起吳紹詩為刑部郎中。

translations.literal: Wu Shaoshi was restored as a director in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaoshi was restored to a punishments bureau directorship.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，調宮兆麟為貴州巡撫，吳達善以湖廣總督兼署湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Gong Zhaolin was transferred to Guizhou governor and Wu Dashan, as Huguang governor-general, concurrently administered Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Gong Zhaolin took Guizhou and Wu Dashan also acted in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上奉皇太后謁泰陵，巡幸天津。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, visited the Tai Mausoleum and toured Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the imperial party visited the Tai tomb and Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor paid visit to the Tai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor visited the Tai tomb.

sentences.zh: 己丑，免經過州縣及天津府屬乾隆三十一年至三十三年積欠地糧銀及常借災借穀石，直隸乾隆三十一年至三十三年積欠地糧銀及折色銀兩。

translations.literal: On day jichou, accumulated land-tax silver and usual and disaster grain loans owed from Qianlong 31-33 were remitted for counties the court passed through and Tianjin prefecture; for Zhili, accumulated land-tax silver and commuted silver from 31-33 were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, large tax and grain arrears were forgiven for transit districts, Tianjin, and Zhili.

sentences.zh: 減直隸軍流以下罪。

translations.literal: Punishments below military exile in Zhili were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili sentences below military exile were lessened.

sentences.zh: 免直隸乾隆三十一年至三十三年因災緩徵銀穀。

translations.literal: Silver and grain deferred for disaster in Zhili from Qianlong 31-33 were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili disaster-deferred taxes from 31-33 were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上奉皇太后駐蹕天津府。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, lodged at Tianjin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the imperial party lodged at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上閱駐防兵。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor reviewed garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Emperor reviewed the garrison.

sentences.zh: 經略大學士傅恆還京師，命與福隆安俱仍為總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary and campaign commander Fu Heng returned to the capital; he and Fulung'an were both ordered to resume as directors-general of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng returned to Beijing and resumed Household Department duty with Fulung'an.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，調永德為河南巡撫，薩載署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Yongde was transferred to Henan governor and Sazai appointed acting Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Yongde took Henan and Sazai acted in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the imperial party returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以緬酋索木邦土司線瓮團等，諭責哈國興粉飾遷就，召來京，以長青代為雲南提督。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, because the Burmese chief demanded the Hsenwi native official Xian Wengtuan and others, an edict rebuked Ha Guoxing for glossing over concessions; he was summoned to the capital and Changqing replaced him as Yunnan brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Ha Guoxing was rebuked and recalled for mishandling Burma; Changqing replaced him in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 己未，召傅良來京，命富椿為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Fu Liang was summoned to the capital and Fuchun was made Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Fu Liang was recalled and Fuchun became Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，天津蝗，命楊廷璋督捕。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, locusts struck Tianjin; Yang Tingzhang was ordered to supervise eradication.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Tianjin locusts brought Yang Tingzhang to supervise extermination.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲浙江仁和等八州縣，杭嚴、嘉湖二衛，陝西定遠縣三十四年被水被雹額賦。

translations.literal: That month, registered taxes were remitted for eight Zhejiang prefectures and counties including Renhe, the Hangyan and Jiahu garrisons, and Dingyuan in Shaanxi for flood and hail damage in the thirty-fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: That month, tax remission reached Zhejiang, garrisons, and Shaanxi for flood and hail.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑朔，日食。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day dingchou: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以皇八子擅自進城，褫上書房行走觀保、湯先甲職，並戒諭之。

translations.literal: On day renwu, because the eighth imperial son entered the city without permission, Academy of the Imperial Sons attendants Guanbao and Tang Xianjia were stripped of office and admonished.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Guanbao and Tang Xianjia lost their posts over the eighth son entering the city without leave.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以祈雨命刑部清理庶獄，減軍流以下罪。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, for rain prayer the Ministry of Punishments was ordered to clear ordinary prisons and reduce punishments below military exile.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, rain prayers brought prison review and lighter sentences.

sentences.zh: 閏五月丙午朔，命裘曰修赴薊州、寶坻一帶捕蝗。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, new moon on day bingwu: Qiu Yixiu was sent to Jizhou and Baodi areas to catch locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, Qiu Yixiu was sent to Jizhou and Baodi against locusts.

sentences.zh: 戊申，京師大雨。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Beijing had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Beijing had heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 己未，命溫福為吏部侍郎，在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Wen Fu was made Vice Minister of Personnel and ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Wen Fu became personnel vice minister and joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 甲子，裘曰修以捕蝗不力免，調程景伊為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Qiu Yixiu was dismissed for ineffective locust eradication; Cheng Jingyi was transferred to Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Qiu Yixiu was removed for poor locust work and Cheng Jingyi took Punishments.

sentences.zh: 以范時綬為工部尚書，張若溎為左都御史。

translations.literal: Fan Shishou was made Minister of Works and Zhang Ruowen Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Shishou took Works and Zhang Ruowen became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，諭阿桂等調海蘭察、哈國興進兵。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiashen: A Gui and others were instructed to transfer Hailancha and Ha Guoxing to advance troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, A Gui was told to send Hailancha and Ha Guoxing forward.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，河南永城、江蘇碭山、安徽宿州等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, locusts appeared in Yongcheng in Henan, Dangshan in Jiangsu, Suzhou in Anhui, and other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, locusts struck Yongcheng, Dangshan, Suzhou, and other districts.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，調官保為刑部尚書，素爾納為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Guan Bao was transferred to Minister of Punishments and Su'erna to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Guan Bao took Punishments and Su'erna took Revenue.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命豐升額署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Fengsheng'e was ordered to act as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Fengsheng'e acted as minister of war.

sentences.zh: 甲午，貴州古州苗香要等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Miao chieftains including Xiang'ai of Guzhou in Guizhou were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Guizhou Miao leaders including Xiang'ai were put to death.

sentences.zh: 命侍郎伍納璽往古北口會同提督王進泰查勘水災，發帑銀二萬兩恤之，並開倉賑糶。

translations.literal: An order sent Vice Minister Wu Najian to Gubeikou to join Commissioner-in-Chief Wang Jintai in surveying flood damage, issued twenty thousand taels from the treasury for relief, and opened granaries for relief grain sales.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Najian and Wang Jintai were sent to Gubeikou to survey floods; twenty thousand taels and granary relief were provided.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳朔，李侍堯奏，河仙鎮土官莫士麟請宣諭緬番恢復暹羅，不許。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, new moon on day yisi: Li Shiyao memorialized that Moshi Lin, native official of Hexian Town, asked to instruct Burmese tribes to restore Siam; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh-month new moon of yisi, Li Shiyao reported a plea to rally Burma for Siam; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以增海為黑龍江將軍，溫福為理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Zeng Hai was made Heilongjiang general; Wenfu was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Zeng Hai became Heilongjiang general and Wenfu colonial affairs minister.

sentences.zh: 命和爾精額、伍納璽往古北口籌辦河工。

translations.literal: He'erjinge and Wu Najian were ordered to Gubeikou to arrange river works.
translations.idiomatic: He'erjinge and Wu Najian were sent to Gubeikou for river works.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以小金川與沃克什土司構釁，命四川總督阿爾泰傳集小金川土司勸諭之。

translations.literal: On day renzi, because Lesser Jinchuan had clashed with the Wokeshi native chieftain, Sichuan governor-general Aertai was ordered to summon the Lesser Jinchuan chieftain and admonish him.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Aertai was told to summon the Lesser Jinchuan chief after a clash with Wokeshi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上臨和親王弘晝第視疾。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor went in person to Prince He Hongzhou's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor visited the ailing Prince He Hongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，和親王弘晝卒。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Prince He Hongzhou died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Prince He Hongzhou died.

sentences.zh: 太保大學士傅恆卒。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor and Grand Secretary Fu Heng died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Fu Heng died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賞來京祝嘏之百十二歲原任浙江遂昌縣學訓導王世芳國子監司業銜，並在籍食俸。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Wang Shifang, former educational instructor of Suichang County, Zhejiang, who had come to the capital at one hundred twelve to offer birthday felicitations, was granted the rank of Vice Director of the Imperial College and allowed to draw salary while at home.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the centenarian Wang Shifang received an Imperial College vice-director rank and home salary.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以裴宗錫為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Pei Zongxi was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Pei Zongxi became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，截漕糧二十萬石賑武清等六縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, two hundred thousand piculs of tribute grain were diverted to relieve flood victims in six counties including Wuqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, two hundred thousand piculs of grain relieved floods in six counties including Wuqing.

sentences.zh: 以諾穆親為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Nomuzhin was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Nomuzhin became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，以副將軍阿桂辦事取巧，褫領侍衛內大臣、禮部尚書、鑲紅旗漢軍都統，以內大臣革職留任辦副將軍事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuyin: because Vice General Agui had handled affairs in a perfunctory, opportunistic way, he was stripped of his posts as inner grandee, Minister of Rites, and Bordered Red Banner Han Chinese commander-in-chief, and retained only as inner grandee on reduced status to continue as vice general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the eighth month, Agui lost several ranks for shoddy work but stayed on as vice general.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以永貴為禮部尚書，觀保為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Yonggui was made Minister of Rites; Guanbao was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Yonggui became Minister of Rites and Guanbao left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰奏僧格桑伏罪，交出達木巴宗地方及所掠番民。

translations.literal: Aertai memorialized that Songzhusan had pleaded guilty and surrendered the Damuba stockade region and the Fan people he had seized.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai reported Songzhusan's submission, return of Damuba, and release of captives.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命劉統勛兼管吏部。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Liu Tongxun was ordered concurrently to supervise the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Liu Tongxun was also put in charge of Personnel.
