sentences.zh: 丙戌，萬壽節，上詣皇太后宮行禮。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Longevity Festival: the Emperor went to the Empress Dowager's palace to perform rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor observed the Longevity Festival rites before the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 御太和殿，王以下文武各官進表，行慶賀禮，奉旨停止筵宴。

translations.literal: At the Hall of Supreme Harmony, princes down to civil and military officials presented memorials of congratulation and performed celebration rites; by imperial order the banquet was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Congratulatory rites were held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony, but the banquet was canceled.

sentences.zh: 命豐升額在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Fengsheng'e was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Fengsheng'e joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上奉皇太后幸熱河。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, went to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the court went to Rehe with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上奉皇太后駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the court lodged at the Summer Mountain Resort.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor went to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，命阿爾泰為武英殿大學士，仍留辦四川總督事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingwu: Aertai was made Wuying Hall Grand Secretary while remaining to handle Sichuan governor-general affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the ninth month, Aertai became Wuying Grand Secretary and kept Sichuan duties.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor returned and halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Emperor returned to the Summer Mountain Resort.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命高晉兼署漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Gao Jin was ordered to act concurrently as Canal Transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Gao Jin also acted as canal transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，上奉皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day guiyou: the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth-month new moon of guiyou, the court returned with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，召崔應階來京，命鍾音署閩浙總督。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Cui Yingjie was summoned to the capital; Zhong Yin was ordered to act as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Cui Yingjie was called to Beijing and Zhong Yin acted in Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，召阿爾泰來京，以德福署四川總督，吳達善兼署湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Aertai was summoned to the capital; Defu acted as Sichuan governor-general, and Wudashan concurrently acted as Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Aertai was recalled; Defu and Wudashan acted in Sichuan and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 召薩載來京，命李湖署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Sazai was summoned to the capital; Lihu was ordered to act as Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Sazai was called to Beijing and Lihu acted in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 甲午，阿桂等奏老官屯緬目遣使致書，請停今歲進兵，允之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Agui and others memorialized that Burmese officials at Laoguandun had sent envoys with letters asking to halt this year's advance; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Agui reported a Burmese plea to suspend operations this year; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大學士陳宏謀以衰病乞休，溫旨慰留。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Grand Secretary Chen Hongmou begged retirement on account of age and illness; a warm edict urged him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Chen Hongmou sought retirement for illness and was warmly told to stay.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，免新疆本年額糧十分之三。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu: this year's registered grain tax for Xinjiang was remitted by three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the twelfth month, Xinjiang's grain tax was cut by thirty percent.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以崔應階為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Cui Yingjie was made Canal Transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Cui Yingjie became canal transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，諭阿桂、彰寶密議進剿緬匪。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Agui and Zhang Bao were instructed secretly to plan an advance against Burmese bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Agui and Zhang Bao were told to plan a Burma campaign in secret.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以李湖為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Lihu was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Lihu became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 三十六年春正月甲辰，免福建台灣府屬本年額徵粟米。

translations.literal: Thirty-sixth year, spring, first month, day jiachen: this year's registered grain for Taiwan prefecture and its subordinates in Fujian was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, first month of jiachen, Taiwan's grain tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，免廣東廣州、韶州等府州屬本年官租十分之一，廣西桂林七府州屬本年官租及桂林平樂等府州學租十分之三。

translations.literal: On day yisi, one-tenth of this year's official rent was remitted for Guangdong prefectures and departments including Guangzhou and Shaozhou; three-tenths of official rent and school rent for seven Guilin prefectures and departments in Guangxi, and for Guilin and Pinglo prefectures and departments, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, rent remissions were granted in Guangdong and Guangxi districts.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免四川寧遠等四府州屬、建昌鎮標各營、雷波等廳民番本年額糧。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, this year's registered grain was remitted for four prefectures and departments including Ningyuan in Sichuan, for garrisons under Jianchang command, and for the Leibo and other subprefectures of Han and Fan people.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Sichuan grain taxes were remitted in Ningyuan and other districts.

sentences.zh: 己未，調德福署雲貴總督，命阿爾泰回四川總督任。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Defu was transferred to act as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Aertai was ordered back to the Sichuan governor-general post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Defu acted in Yunnan-Guizhou and Aertai returned to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，上奉皇太后東巡。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu: the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, toured east.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the second month, the court made an eastern tour with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命內大臣巴圖濟爾噶勒會同集福讞烏梁海副都統莫尼紥布等互控之案。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, inner grandee Batu Jiergale was ordered jointly with Jifu to try the mutual accusations of Uriankhai vice commander-in-chief Monizhabu and others.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Batu Jiergale and Jifu were assigned to judge Uriankhai officials' suits.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大學士陳宏謀以病乞休，允之，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Grand Secretary Chen Hongmou begged retirement on account of illness; this was granted, and he was given the additional title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Chen Hongmou retired for illness and received Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 免直隸滄州等十五州縣民欠借穀，並武清縣本年錢糧十分之五。

translations.literal: Grain loans owed by the people of fifteen Zhili prefectures and counties including Cangzhou were remitted, and this year's money and grain tax for Wuqing County was remitted by five-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili loan grain was forgiven in fifteen districts and Wuqing's tax was halved.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命侍郎裘曰修會同楊廷璋、周元理籌辦直隸河工。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Qiu Yuexiu was ordered jointly with Yang Tingzhang and Zhou Yuanli to arrange Zhili river works.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Yuexiu, Yang Tingzhang, and Zhou Yuanli were sent to manage Zhili rivers.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，免山東經過州縣本年額賦十分之三、災地十分之五。

translations.literal: This year's registered tax was remitted by three-tenths for Zhili transit districts and by five-tenths for disaster districts in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong transit taxes were cut thirty percent and disaster districts fifty percent.

sentences.zh: 免山東泰安等二縣本年地丁錢糧。

translations.literal: This year's land-and-poll tax for two Shandong counties including Tai'an was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tai'an and one other Shandong county had land tax remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，免山東濟南各屬民欠借穀及東平州、東平所逋賦。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, grain loans owed by the people under Jinan and other Shandong prefectures were remitted, as were back taxes for Dongping Prefecture and Dongping Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Jinan loan grain and Dongping arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 以阿桂請大舉征緬，申飭之。

translations.literal: Because Agui had requested a major campaign against Burma, he was sternly rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: Agui was rebuked for urging a large Burma expedition.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，免山東濟南等六府屬民欠麥本銀兩。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, wheat principal and silver owed by the people under six Jinan prefectures in Shandong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, wheat debts in six Jinan prefectures were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 命劉綸為大學士，兼管工部，于敏中協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Liu Lun was made Grand Secretary and concurrently supervised the Board of Works; Yu Minzhong assisted as Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lun became grand secretary over Works; Yu Minzhong assisted.

sentences.zh: 調程景伊為吏部尚書，范時綬為刑部尚書，以裘曰修為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Cheng Jingyi was transferred to Minister of Personnel; Fan Shishou to Minister of Punishments; Qiu Yuexiu to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Jingyi, Fan Shishou, and Qiu Yuexiu were shifted to Personnel, Punishments, and Works.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上奉皇太后褐岱嶽廟，上登泰山。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, visited the Daiyue Temple and ascended Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the court visited Daiyue Temple and climbed Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上至曲阜謁先師孔子廟。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor reached Qufu and visited the temple of Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor visited Confucius's temple at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上釋奠先師孔子。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor performed the sacrifice to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor offered sacrifice to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上謁孔林。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor visited the Kong family grove.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor visited the Kong grove.

sentences.zh: 祭少昊陵、元聖周公廟。

translations.literal: Sacrifice was offered at the tomb of Shaohao and at the temple of the Primordial Sage Duke of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The court sacrificed at Shaohao's tomb and Duke of Zhou's temple.

sentences.zh: 賜衍聖公孔昭煥族人銀幣有差。

translations.literal: Silver and coins were bestowed in graded amounts on the Duke of Yansheng Kong Zhaohuan and his clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Zhaohuan and his kin received graded gifts of silver and coins.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上奉皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the court returned with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，予大學士尹繼善等、尚書官保等、總督楊廷璋等、巡撫鍾音等議敘。

translations.literal: On day yimao, graded commendations were granted to Grand Secretary Yin Jishan and others, Ministers Guanbao and others, governor-general Yang Tingzhang and others, and governors Zhong Yin and others.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Yin Jishan, Guanbao, Yang Tingzhang, Zhong Yin, and others received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 內閣學士陸宗楷等原品休致。

translations.literal: Cabinet Academician Lu Zongkai and others retired at their original rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zongkai and other academicians retired in grade.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以富明安為閩浙總督、周元理為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Fuming'an was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Zhou Yuanli was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Fuming'an took Fujian-Zhejiang and Zhou Yuanli Shandong.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以甘肅比歲偏災，免通省民欠籽種口糧倉穀。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, because Gansu had suffered successive partial disasters in recent years, seed grain, ration grain, and granary stocks owed by the people throughout the province were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Gansu seed, ration, and granary debts were forgiven after repeated disasters.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上至捷地閱堤。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor reached Jiedi to inspect the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Emperor inspected dikes at Jiedi.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，納遜特古斯處斬。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Nasuntegusi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Nasuntegusi was put to death.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以阿桂奏辨非於本年大舉征緬，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day jisi, because Agui had memorialized that a major Burma campaign was not appropriate this year, the matter was referred to the ministries for strict deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Agui's plea against a Burma campaign this year was sent for strict review.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未朔，以李侍堯為內大臣。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, new moon on day xinwei: Li Shiyao was made inner grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth-month new moon of xinwei, Li Shiyao became inner grandee.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命戶部侍郎桂林在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Revenue Vice Minister Guilin was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Guilin joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the court returned to Beijing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以旱命刑部清理庶獄，減軍流以下罪，直隸亦如之。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because of drought the Board of Punishments was ordered to clear ordinary prisons and reduce punishments for exiles and below; Zhili was treated likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, drought led to prison reviews and sentence reductions in the capital and Zhili.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大學士尹繼善卒。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Grand Secretary Yin Jishan died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Yin Jishan died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜黃軒等一百六十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Huang Xuan and one hundred sixty-one others were granted jinshi and other degrees with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Huang Xuan and 161 others received jinshi and related degrees.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑朔，調吳達善為陝甘總督，文綬署之，勒爾謹護陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day xinchou: Wudashan was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general; Wenshou acted in the post; Le'erjin guarded Shaanxi as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon of xinchou, Wudashan, Wenshou, and Le'erjin were shifted in northwest posts.

sentences.zh: 調富明安為湖廣總督，永德為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Fuming'an was transferred to Huguang governor-general; Yongde was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Fuming'an became Huguang governor-general and Yongde Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 以何煟為河南巡撫，兼管河務，鍾音為閩浙總督，余文儀為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: He Wei was made Henan governor and concurrently supervised river affairs; Zhong Yin was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Yu Wenyi was made Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: He Wei took Henan with river duties; Zhong Yin Fujian-Zhejiang; Yu Wenyi Fujian.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命減秋審緩決三次人犯罪。

translations.literal: On day guimao, an order reduced punishments for those in autumn review whose sentences had been deferred three times.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, thrice-deferred autumn-review sentences were reduced.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，諭立決人犯當省刑之際，暫緩行刑，著為令。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, an edict ordered that when summary executions fell at a time for sparing punishments, execution was temporarily suspended; this was made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, summary executions were to be paused during mercy seasons by standing rule.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，阿桂以畏葸褫職，降兵丁效力。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Agui was stripped of office for timidity and reduced to soldier service.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Agui lost rank for cowardice and served as a common soldier.

sentences.zh: 命溫福馳赴雲南署副將軍事。

translations.literal: Wenfu was ordered to hurry to Yunnan to act as vice general.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu was rushed to Yunnan as acting vice general.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以高晉為文華殿大學士，兼禮部尚書，仍留兩江總督任。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Gao Jin was made Wenhua Hall Grand Secretary and concurrently Minister of Rites while remaining in the Jiangnan governor-general post.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Gao Jin became Wenhua Grand Secretary over Rites and kept Jiangnan duties.

sentences.zh: 召阿爾泰入閣辦事，以德福為四川總督。

translations.literal: Aertai was summoned to serve in the Grand Secretariat; Defu was made Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai entered the Grand Secretariat; Defu became Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，直隸北運河決。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinwei: the Northern Grand Canal in Zhili burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinwei, Zhili's Northern Grand Canal broke.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以努三為正黃旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Nu San was made inner grandee of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Nu San became Bordered Yellow Banner inner grandee.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命巴圖濟爾噶勒赴伊犁辦土爾扈特投誠事宜。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Batu Jiergale was ordered to proceed to Ili to handle the submission of the Torghuts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Batu Jiergale went to Ili for the Torghut submission.

sentences.zh: 己卯，諭土爾扈特投誠大台吉均令來避暑山莊朝覲，命額駙色布騰巴勒珠爾馳驛迎之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, an edict ordered that great taiji of the submitting Torghuts all come to the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat for audience; imperial son-in-law Sebten Balzhur was ordered post-haste to welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Torghut leaders were summoned to the Summer Resort and Sebten Balzhur sent to meet them.

sentences.zh: 壬午，致仕大學士陳宏謀卒。

translations.literal: On day renchen, retired Grand Secretary Chen Hongmou died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the retired Chen Hongmou died.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命土爾扈特部眾暫駐博羅博拉。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Torghut tribes were ordered temporarily to camp at Boluobola.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Torghuts were lodged temporarily at Boluobola.

sentences.zh: 以金川土舍索諾木請賞給革布什咱土司人民，命阿爾泰詳酌機宜，毋姑息。

translations.literal: Because Jinchuan native clerk Suonuomu asked that the people of the Gexi Bushi native chieftain be rewarded, Aertai was ordered to weigh the occasion carefully and not show undue leniency.
translations.idiomatic: On Suonuomu's plea for Gexi Bushi rewards, Aertai was told to act firmly, not leniently.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，阿爾泰等奏小金川土舍圍攻沃克什，命剿之。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, day renyin: Aertai and others memorialized that Lesser Jinchuan native clerks were besieging Wokeshi; an order was issued to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the seventh month, Aertai reported a Lesser Jinchuan siege of Wokeshi and suppression was ordered.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命侍郎桂林帶銀一萬兩赴古北口會同提督王進泰賑水災。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Vice Minister Guilin was ordered to take ten thousand taels of silver to Gubeikou to join Commissioner-in-Chief Wang Jintai in relieving flood victims.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Guilin took ten thousand taels to Gubeikou with Wang Jintai for flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，永定河決。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Yongding River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Yongding River broke.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命舒赫德署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Shuhede was ordered to act as Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Shuhede acted as Ili general.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor conducted the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 以小金川復侵明正土司，諭阿爾泰等進剿。

translations.literal: Because Lesser Jinchuan again invaded the Mingzheng native chieftain, Aertai and others were instructed to advance in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser Jinchuan's renewed attack on Mingzheng led to orders for Aertai to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上奉皇太后啟鑾。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, set out on the return journey.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the court began returning with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the court lodged at the Summer Mountain Resort.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以此次巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, on account of this tour to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, on account of the Mulan tour.

sentences.zh: 沿途武職懈忽，楊廷璋、王進泰等均下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Military officials along the route had been negligent; Yang Tingzhang, Wang Jintai, and others were all referred to the ministries for strict deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Negligent route officers including Yang Tingzhang and Wang Jintai were sent for strict review.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，定邊左副將軍、喀爾喀紥薩克和碩親王成袞紥布卒，以車布登紥布為定邊左副將軍，額駙拉旺多爾濟襲紥薩克和碩親王。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: Pacification Vice General of the Left Frontier and Khalkha Zhasak Heshuo Prince Chenggun Zhabu died; Chebudun Zhabu was made Pacification Vice General of the Left Frontier, and imperial son-in-law Lawang Duoerji succeeded as Zhasak Heshuo Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the eighth month, Chenggun Zhabu died; Chebudun Zhabu and Lawang Duoerji received frontier and princely posts.

sentences.zh: 罷德福軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Defu was removed from service at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Defu left the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，召大學士兩江總督高晉來京，查勘永定河工。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Grand Secretary and Liangjiang governor-general Gao Jin was summoned to the capital to inspect Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Gao Jin was recalled from Liangjiang to inspect the Yongding River.

sentences.zh: 命薩載兼署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Saizai was ordered to act concurrently as Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Saizai was told to act at Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，永定河決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Yongding River breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Yongding breach closed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor proceeded to Mulan for the battue.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Emperor went to Mulan to hunt.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命阿爾泰仍管四川總督事，召德福回京。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Altai was ordered to continue managing Sichuan governor-general affairs and Defu was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Altai kept Sichuan duties and Defu was recalled.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌朔，停本年勾決。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day wuxu: this year's review of capital sentences was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth-month new moon, wuxu, capital executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命理藩院侍郎慶桂在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Lifanyuan Vice Minister Qing Gui was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Qing Gui joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，土爾扈特台吉渥巴錫等入覲，賞頂戴冠服有差。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Torghut taiji Ubashi and others had audience and were rewarded with rank insignia and court dress in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Ubashi and other Torghut taiji were received and given graded insignia and robes.

sentences.zh: 命副將軍溫福、參贊大臣伍岱赴四川軍營，會商進剿。

translations.literal: Vice General Wenfu and Grand Minister Consultant Wu Dai were ordered to the Sichuan army camp to consult on the advance and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu and Wu Dai were sent to the Sichuan front to plan the campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封渥巴錫為烏納恩素珠克圖舊土爾扈特部卓哩克圖汗，策伯克多爾濟為烏納恩素珠克圖舊土爾扈特部布延圖親王，舍楞為青塞特奇勒圖新土爾扈特部弼哩克圖郡王，巴木巴爾為畢錫哷勒圖郡王，餘各錫爵有差。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Ubashi was enfeoffed as Khan of the Old Torghut Choliktu under Unaen Sizhuketu; Tsebek Dorji as Prince Buyantu of the Old Torghut; Sele as Prince Biliktu of the New Torghut under Cisit Qilitu; Bambal as Prince Bixiletu; and the rest received peerages in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Ubashi and other Torghut leaders received khan, prince, and lesser titles in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor returned and halted at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以文綬為四川總督，勒爾謹為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Wenshou was made Sichuan governor and Le'erjin Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Wenshou became Sichuan governor and Le'erjin Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 調永德為廣西巡撫，梁國治為湖南巡撫，陳輝祖為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Yongde was transferred to Guangxi governor, Liang Guozhi to Hunan governor, and Chen Huizu to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yongde, Liang Guozhi, and Chen Huizu were reassigned to Guangxi, Hunan, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰朔，以三寶為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day wuchen: Sanbao was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth-month new moon, wuchen, Sanbao became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上奉皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager in returning the imperial progress.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the court escorted the Empress Dowager on the return journey.

sentences.zh: 以舒赫德為總統伊犁等處將軍，伊勒圖為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣，安泰為烏什參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Shuhede was made general-in-chief presiding over Yili and other places; Iletu Tarbagatai grand minister consultant; Antai Ush grand minister consultant.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede headed Yili; Iletu took Tarbagatai and Antai took Ush.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，宥紀昀，賞翰林院編修。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Ji Yun was pardoned and granted Hanlin Academician Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Ji Yun was pardoned and made Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the court returned to Beijing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 己卯，高晉等奏桃源廳陳家道口河工合龍，上嘉之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Gao Jin and others reported the Chenjiakou river works at Taoyuan subprefecture closed; the Emperor praised this.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Gao Jin reported the Taoyuan Chenjiakou works closed and was praised.

sentences.zh: 命高晉、裘曰修、楊廷璋查勘南運河。

translations.literal: Gao Jin, Qiu Yuexiu, and Yang Tingzhang were ordered to inspect the Southern Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin, Qiu Yuexiu, and Yang Tingzhang were sent to inspect the Southern Canal.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，召楊廷璋為刑部尚書，以周元理為直隸總督，徐績為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Yang Tingzhang was summoned as Minister of Punishments; Zhou Yuanli was made Zhili governor-general and Xu Ji Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Yang Tingzhang became Minister of Punishments; Zhou Yuanli took Zhili and Xu Ji Shandong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，陝甘總督吳達善卒，調文綬代之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Wu Dashan died; Wenshou was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Wu Dashan died and Wenshou replaced him in Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，董天弼奏攻取小金川牛廠。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiyou: Dong Tianbi reported capturing the Lesser Jinchuan Niuchang stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, jiyou, Dong Tianbi took Lesser Jinchuan Niuchang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上奉皇太后御慈寧宮，恭上徽號曰崇慶慈宣康惠敦和裕壽純禧恭懿安祺皇太后，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Cining Palace and ceremonially offered the honorific title Chongqing Cixuan Kanghui Dunhe Yushou Chunxi Gongyi Anqi Empress Dowager; an amnesty edict was issued with differing favors.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Empress Dowager received a long honorific at Cining and a graded amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 以溫福為武英殿大學士，兼兵部尚書，桂林為四川總督。

translations.literal: Wenfu was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory and concurrently Minister of War; Guilin became Sichuan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu became War Minister and grand secretary; Guilin became Sichuan governor.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，調素爾納為理藩院尚書，以舒赫德為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Suo'erna was transferred to Lifanyuan Minister and Shuhede Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Suo'erna took Lifanyuan and Shuhede took Revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，皇太后萬壽聖節，上詣壽康宮，率王大臣行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, on the Empress Dowager's Longevity Festival the Emperor went to Shoukang Palace and led princes and ministers in congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Emperor led court congratulations at Shoukang for the Empress Dowager's birthday.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，董天弼進攻達木巴宗，失利。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Dong Tianbi attacked Dambazong and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Dong Tianbi failed at Dambazong.

sentences.zh: 甲子，小金川番復陷牛廠。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Lesser Jinchuan tribes recaptured Niuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Lesser Jinchuan retook Niuchang.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，溫福奏進駐向陽坪，攻小金川巴朗拉山碉卡，不克。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengwu: Wenfu reported advancing headquarters to Xiangyangping and attacking Balangla mountain blockhouses in Lesser Jinchuan without success.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, gengwu, Wenfu attacked Balangla blockhouses from Xiangyangping and failed.

sentences.zh: 桂林奏克小金川約咱寨。

translations.literal: Guilin reported capturing Yueza stockade in Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin reported taking Lesser Jinchuan Yueza.

sentences.zh: 褫四川提督董天弼職，以阿桂署之。

translations.literal: Sichuan provincial military commander Dong Tianbi was stripped of office; Agui was ordered to act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Tianbi lost his Sichuan command and Agui acted in his stead.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，蠲甘肅隴西等三十三州縣三十三年被水旱雹霜等災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, quota tax was remitted for thirty-three Gansu prefectures and counties including Longxi for water, drought, hail, and frost disasters of the thirty-third year.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, thirty-three Gansu districts including Longxi were forgiven disaster taxes for year 33.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以大金川酋僧格桑遣土目赴桂林軍營獻物，命給賞遣歸。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, because Greater Jinchuan chief Songge Sang sent a tribal envoy to Guilin's camp with gifts, orders were given to reward and send him back.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Songge Sang's envoy to Guilin was rewarded and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，溫福奏克巴朗拉碉卡。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Wenfu reported capturing Balangla blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Wenfu took Balangla blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，溫福奏進駐日隆宗地方，董天弼收復沃克什土司各寨。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Wenfu reported advancing headquarters to Rilongzong; Dong Tianbi recovered the Woqeshi chieftain's stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Wenfu moved to Rilongzong and Dong Tianbi retook Woqeshi stockades.

sentences.zh: 三十七年春正月辛丑，免奉天錦州二府額徵米豆。

translations.literal: Thirty-seventh year, spring, first month, day xinchou: quota rice and beans were remitted for Fengtian and Jinzhou prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 37, xinchou, Fengtian and Jinzhou lost quota rice and beans.

sentences.zh: 免浙江玉環、海寧兩廳縣額徵銀穀。

translations.literal: Quota silver and grain were remitted for Yuhuan and Haining subprefectures in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's Yuhuan and Haining lost quota silver and grain.

sentences.zh: 免山西大同等二府額徵兵餉米豆穀麥，並太原等十四府州及歸化城各屬十分之三。

translations.literal: Quota military rations in rice, beans, grain, and wheat were remitted for Datong and one other Shanxi prefecture; three-tenths of quotas for fourteen prefectures including Taiyuan and Guihuacheng dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi military rations were forgiven at Datong and elsewhere; Taiyuan and thirteen others lost three-tenths of quota.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，免和林格爾等處及太僕寺牧廠地畝額徵銀，並清水河廳額徵銀及太僕寺牧廠地畝額徵米豆十分之三。

translations.literal: On day renchen, quota silver for grazing lands at Horinger and other places and the Imperial Stud pastures was remitted, and three-tenths of quota silver and rice and beans at Qingshuihe subprefecture and Stud pastures.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Horinger and Stud pasture taxes were forgiven; Qingshuihe lost three-tenths of silver and grain.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，刑部尚書楊廷璋卒，以崔應階為刑部尚書，嘉謨署漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Minister of Punishments Yang Tingzhang died; Cui Yingjie was made Minister of Punishments and Jiamo acted as grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Yang Tingzhang died; Cui Yingjie took Punishments and Jiamo acted at grain transport.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，溫福奏攻克小金川曾頭溝、卡丫碉卡。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Wenfu reported capturing Zengtougou and Kay blockhouses in Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Wenfu took Zengtougou and Kay in Lesser Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，桂林奏克郭松、甲木各碉卡。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Guilin reported capturing Guosong and Jiamu blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Guilin took Guosong and Jiamu blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以恆祿為內大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Hengluo was made inner grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Hengluo became an inner grand minister.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，建烏魯木齊城，駐兵屯田。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Urumqi city was built and troops stationed for colonization farming.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Urumqi was walled and garrisoned for farming.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命尚書裘曰修協同直隸總督周元理濬永定河、北運河。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Minister Qiu Yuexiu was ordered with Zhili governor-general Zhou Yuanli to dredge the Yongding and Northern Grand Canals.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Qiu Yuexiu and Zhou Yuanli were told to dredge the Yongding and Northern Canal.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，以阿桂為四川軍營參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingmao: Agui was made campaign consultant minister in the Sichuan army.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, dingmao, Agui became a Sichuan campaign consultant.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上幸盤山。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor visited Panshan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor went to Panshan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上迴鑾，幸圓明園。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor returned the progress and proceeded to the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the court returned and went to the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以色布騰巴勒珠爾為四川軍營參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Sebten Balzhur was made campaign consultant minister in the Sichuan army.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Sebten Balzhur became a Sichuan campaign consultant.

sentences.zh: 乙未，免陝西西安等十二府州上年額徵本色租糧。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, original-form rent grain for twelve Shaanxi prefectures including Xi'an for the previous year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, twelve Shaanxi districts including Xi'an lost last year's rent grain.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申朔，免江蘇金壇等十一州縣六年至十年逋賦。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day bingshen: arrears from years six through ten were remitted for eleven Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Jintan.
translations.idiomatic: On the third-month new moon, bingshen, eleven Jiangsu districts including Jintan lost arrears from years 6–10.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以索諾木策凌為烏魯木齊參贊大臣，德云為領隊大臣，命俱受伊犁將軍節制。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Sonom Tablai was made Urumqi grand minister consultant, Degyun expedition commander, both under Yili general's command.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Sonom Tablai took Urumqi and Degyun led the column, both under Yili.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以豐升額為四川軍營參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Fengsheng'e was made Sichuan army campaign consultant minister.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Fengsheng'e became a Sichuan campaign consultant.

sentences.zh: 己酉，河南羅山縣在籍知縣查世柱，以藏匿明史輯要，論斬。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Luo Shan county retired magistrate Zha Shizhu was sentenced to decapitation for concealing the Ming History compilation Essentials.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Zha Shizhu was executed for hiding the Ming History Essentials.

sentences.zh: 壬子，桂林奏攻克大金川所據革布什咱土司之木巴拉等處。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Guilin reported capturing Mubala and other places held by Greater Jinchuan in the Gurbushi chieftain's domain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Guilin retook Gurbushi lands seized by Greater Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，溫福奏攻克小金川資哩碉寨。

translations.literal: On day maoyin, Wenfu reported capturing the Zili stockade in Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On maoyin day, Wenfu took Lesser Jinchuan Zili.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，桂林奏攻克吉地官寨。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Guilin reported capturing the Jidi stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Guilin took Jidi stockade.

sentences.zh: 溫福奏攻克小金川阿克木雅寨。

translations.literal: Wenfu reported capturing the Akemuya stockade in Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu reported taking Lesser Jinchuan Akemuya.

sentences.zh: 桂林奏攻克革布什咱土司之黨哩等寨，及小金川紥哇窠崖下碉卡。

translations.literal: Guilin reported capturing Dangli and other stockades of the Gurbushi chieftain and blockhouses below Zhawakeiya in Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin took Gurbushi Dangli and other stockades and Zhawakeiya blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅朔，桂林奏攻克小金川阿仰東山樑等寨。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, new moon on day bingyin: Guilin reported capturing Ayangdong Shanliang and other stockades in Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth-month new moon, bingyin, Guilin took Ayangdong Shanliang and other Lesser Jinchuan stockades.

sentences.zh: 豁甘肅節年民欠倉糧三百七十六萬石有奇。

translations.literal: Stored grain arrears owed by the people over the years in Gansu totaling more than 3.76 million shi were written off.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu granary arrears above 3.76 million shi were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬申，桂林奏盡復革布什咱土司之地，及攻克小金川格烏等處。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Guilin reported fully recovering Gurbushi chieftain territory and capturing Gewu and other places in Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Guilin restored all Gurbushi lands and took Gewu and other Lesser Jinchuan sites.

sentences.zh: 諭溫福、桂林進剿索諾木。

translations.literal: Wenfu and Guilin were instructed to advance and suppress Suonuomu.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu and Guilin were ordered to press the attack on Suonuomu.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，授李湖雲南巡撫，圖思德貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Li Hu was appointed Yunnan governor and Tu Side Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Li Hu took Yunnan and Tu Side Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，改安西道為巴里坤屯田糧務兵備道，甘肅道為安肅兵備道，涼庄道為甘涼兵備道。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Anxi circuit was changed to Barkol colonization and grain transport defense circuit; the Gansu circuit to Ansu defense circuit; the Liangzhuang circuit to Ganliang defense circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Anxi, Gansu, and Liangzhuang circuits were reorganized as Barkol, Ansu, and Ganliang defense circuits.

sentences.zh: 裁烏魯木齊糧道。

translations.literal: The Urumqi grain circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Urumqi grain circuit was ended.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賜金榜等一百六十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Jin Bang and 161 others were granted jinshi with differing ranks of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Jin Bang and 161 others received jinshi degrees in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲午，桂林攻小金川達烏東岸山樑，失利。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Guilin attacked the Dawu east-bank mountain ridge in Lesser Jinchuan and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Guilin failed at Dawu's east-bank ridge.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未朔，以溫福劾色布騰巴勒珠爾貽誤軍務，褫爵職。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day yimao: because Wenfu impeached Sebten Balzhur for bungling military affairs, his title and office were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon, yimao, Sebten Balzhur lost rank after Wenfu's impeachment for military failure.

sentences.zh: 丙申，免直隸滄州等十五州縣廳積年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, arrears accumulated over years were remitted for fifteen Zhili prefectures and counties including Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, fifteen Zhili districts including Cangzhou lost long arrears.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以舒赫德為領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Shuhede was made senior imperial bodyguard of the interior.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Shuhede became senior imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 命福隆安赴四川查辦阿爾泰劾桂林乖張捏飾一案。

translations.literal: Fulang'an was ordered to proceed to Sichuan to investigate Altai's impeachment of Guilin for perverse fabrication.
translations.idiomatic: Fulang'an was sent to Sichuan to probe Altai's charge that Guilin had falsified reports.

sentences.zh: 命託庸暫兼管兵部尚書，索爾訥署工部尚書。

translations.literal: Tuoyong was ordered temporarily to manage concurrently as Minister of War; Suo'erna acted as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoyong temporarily took War and Suo'erna acted at Works.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命戶部侍郎福康安在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Vice Minister of Revenue Fukang'an was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Fukang'an joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命海蘭察等赴四川西路軍營，鄂蘭等赴四川南路軍營。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Hailancha and others were ordered to the Western Route Sichuan army camp; Elan and others to the Southern Route camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Hailancha went to the Western Route and Elan to the Southern Route.

sentences.zh: 調容保為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Rongbao was transferred to Suiyuan garrison general.
translations.idiomatic: Rongbao became Suiyuan garrison general.

sentences.zh: 桂林以隱匿挫衄，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Guilin was stripped of office and arrested for concealing defeats.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin was dismissed and arrested for hiding setbacks.

sentences.zh: 以阿爾泰署四川總督。

translations.literal: Altai was ordered to act as Sichuan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Altai was told to act at Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 己未，上奉皇太后幸避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the court went to the Summer Resort with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲子，湖廣總督富明安卒，以海明為湖廣總督，海成為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Huguang governor-general Fuming'an died; Haiming became Huguang governor-general and Haicheng Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Fuming'an died; Haiming took Huguang and Haicheng Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 免直隸大興等十五州縣額賦有差。

translations.literal: Quota tax was remitted with differing measures for fifteen Zhili prefectures and counties including Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen Zhili districts including Daxing lost quota tax in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑朔，上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day yichou: the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager and halted at the Summer Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth-month new moon, yichou, the court halted at the Summer Resort with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 溫福等攻克小金川東瑪寨。

translations.literal: Wenfu and others captured the Dongma stockade in Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu's force took Lesser Jinchuan Dongma.

sentences.zh: 諭阿桂督上中下雜谷及綽斯甲布各土司進剿金川。

translations.literal: Agui was instructed to supervise the upper, middle, and lower Zhaigu and Chuosijiabu native chieftains in advancing against Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Agui was told to lead Zhaigu and Chuosijiabu chiefs against Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，蠲甘肅皋蘭等二十五廳縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, quota tax was remitted for twenty-five Gansu subprefectures and counties including Gaolan for drought disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, twenty-five Gansu districts including Gaolan lost drought quota tax.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，盛京將軍恆祿卒，調增海代之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Shengjing general Hengluo died and Zenghai was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Hengluo died and Zenghai replaced him at Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 以傅玉為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Fu Yu was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yu became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 甲申，調文綬為四川總督，海明為陝甘總督，以勒爾謹署之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Wenshou was transferred to Sichuan governor-general, Haiming to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, with Le'erjin acting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Wenshou took Sichuan, Haiming Shaanxi-Gansu, and Le'erjin acted.

sentences.zh: 命阿爾泰署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Altai was ordered to act as Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Altai was told to act at Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，阿爾泰罷，調海明為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Altai was dismissed; Haiming was transferred to Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Altai was removed and Haiming took Huguang.

sentences.zh: 以勒爾謹署陝甘總督，調富勒渾為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Le'erjin was ordered to act as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general; Fulehun was transferred to Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Le'erjin acted in Shaanxi-Gansu and Fulehun became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 命倉場侍郎劉秉恬赴四川西路軍營督餉。

translations.literal: Granary director Liu Bingqian was ordered to the Western Route Sichuan army camp to supervise supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bingqian was sent to the Western Route to oversee rations.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，湖廣總督海明卒，以富勒渾代之，陳輝祖署。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Huguang governor-general Haiming died; Fulehun replaced him with Chen Huizu acting.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Haiming died; Fulehun succeeded with Chen Huizu acting.

sentences.zh: 命巴延三為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Bayansan was appointed Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Bayansan became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，命刑部侍郎鄂寶赴四川南路軍營督餉，授勒爾謹陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day yimao: Vice Minister of Punishments Ebao was ordered to the Southern Route Sichuan army camp to supervise supplies; Le'erjin was granted Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, yimao, Ebao oversaw Southern Route supplies and Le'erjin received Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，阿桂奏攻克小金川甲爾木山樑碉卡。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi: Agui reported capturing Airmu Shanliang blockhouses in Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jisi, Agui took Lesser Jinchuan Airmu Shanliang blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 以阿桂為內大臣。

translations.literal: Agui was made inner grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: Agui became an inner grand minister.

sentences.zh: 賞布拉克底土司安多爾「恭順」名號，巴旺土婦伽讓「恭懿」名號。

translations.literal: The Bulakdi chieftain Andor was granted the honorific name Gongshun and the Bawang native chieftainess Jarang the name Gongyi.
translations.idiomatic: Bulakdi's Andor received the style Gongshun and Bawang's Jarang Gongyi.

sentences.zh: 壬申，溫福等奏小金川賊襲瑪爾迪克運路，海蘭察等敗之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Wenfu and others reported Lesser Jinchuan bandits raiding the Maldike transport route; Hailancha and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Wenfu reported a raid on the Maldike supply line and Hailancha beat the attackers back.

sentences.zh: 己丑，小金川犯黨壩官寨，阿桂遣董天弼援之。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Lesser Jinchuan rebels attacked the Dangba official stockade; A Gui sent Dong Tianbi to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Lesser Jinchuan struck Dangba and A Gui sent Dong Tianbi to reinforce.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，溫福奏進至木蘭壩，賊毀南北兩山碉卡，聚守路頂宗山樑。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: Wen Fu memorialized that the army had advanced to Mulan Dam; rebels destroyed blockhouses on both northern and southern hills and massed to hold Ludingzong Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Wen Fu reported reaching Mulan Dam as rebels wrecked hill blockhouses and held Ludingzong Ridge.

sentences.zh: 諭嚴防後路。

translations.literal: An edict ordered strict guarding of the rear route.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the rear route strictly guarded.

sentences.zh: 阿桂奏綽斯甲布土司分兵進攻勒烏圍。

translations.literal: A Gui memorialized that the Chosiakabu chieftain had divided forces to attack Lewu stockade.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui reported Chosiakabu troops advancing on Lewu stockade.

sentences.zh: 上送皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: The Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on her return from progress.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor saw the Empress Dowager home from her journey.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上自避暑山莊迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor returned from progress at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor left the Summer Resort for the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上奏皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor reported to the Empress Dowager that they had returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor announced their return to Beijing to the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，董天弼奏攻克穆陽岡等卡。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renshen: Dong Tianbi memorialized the capture of blockhouses including Muyanggang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Dong Tianbi reported taking Muyanggang blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 壬午，阿桂奏攻克小金川甲爾木山樑。

translations.literal: On day renwu, A Gui memorialized the capture of Lesser Jinchuan's Jiaermu Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, A Gui reported taking Jiaermu Ridge in Lesser Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，溫福等奏攻克路頂宗及喀木色爾碉寨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiwei: Wen Fu and others memorialized the capture of Ludingzong and Khamser stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Wen Fu's force took Ludingzong and Khamser stockades.

sentences.zh: 丙申，除四川樂山等九州縣三十五年坍廢鹽井額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, quota tax on collapsed salt wells for thirty-five years was remitted in nine Sichuan prefectures and counties including Leshan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, thirty-five years of abandoned salt-well tax was forgiven in nine Sichuan districts including Leshan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，廣州將軍秦璜以納僕婦為妾，褫職逮訊。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Guangzhou General Qin Huang was stripped of office and arrested for taking a maidservant as concubine.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Qin Huang lost his Guangzhou post over a maidservant scandal.

sentences.zh: 設涼州副都統。

translations.literal: A Liangzhou vice commander-in-chief was established.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzhou gained a new vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 裁西安副都統一。

translations.literal: One Xi'an vice commander-in-chief was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: One Xi'an vice commander post was cut.

sentences.zh: 丙午，溫福等奏克博爾根山等碉寨。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Wen Fu and others memorialized the capture of stockades including Bo'ergen Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Wen Fu reported taking Bo'ergen Mountain stockades.

sentences.zh: 戊申，阿桂奏攻克翁古爾壟等城寨。

translations.literal: On day wushen, A Gui memorialized the capture of stockades including Wenguerlong.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, A Gui took Wenguerlong and nearby stockades.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命富勒渾赴四川，以陳輝祖兼署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Fulehun was ordered to Sichuan; Chen Huizu was made acting Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Fulehun was sent to Sichuan and Chen Huizu acted at Huguang.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，阿桂奏攻克得里等碉寨。

translations.literal: On day guichou, A Gui memorialized the capture of stockades including Deli.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, A Gui reported taking Deli stockades.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，阿桂奏攻克邦甲、拉宗等處，拉約各寨番人降。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, A Gui memorialized the capture of Bangjia, Lazong, and other places; fan of Layue stockades submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, A Gui took Bangjia and Lazong and Layue fan submitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，阿桂奏攻克僧格宗碉寨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai: A Gui memorialized the capture of Sengge stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, A Gui reported taking Sengge stockade.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以溫福為定邊將軍，阿桂、豐升額俱為副將軍，舒常、海蘭察、哈國興俱為參贊大臣，福康安為領隊大臣，復興等為溫福一路領隊大臣，興兆等為阿桂一路領隊大臣，董天弼等為豐升額一路領隊大臣。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Wen Fu was made Pacification General for the Border; A Gui and Fengsheng'e were both made deputy generals; Shu Chang, Hailancha, and Ha Guoxing were all made participating ministers; Fu Kang'an was made lead commander; Fuxing and others were lead commanders on Wen Fu's route, Xingzhao and others on A Gui's route, and Dong Tianbi and others on Fengsheng'e's route.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Wen Fu became border general with A Gui and Fengsheng'e as deputies; Shu Chang, Hailancha, and Ha Guoxing coordinated; three columns received lead commanders under Wen Fu, A Gui, and Fengsheng'e.

sentences.zh: 賞給綽斯甲布土司工噶諾爾布「尊追歸丹」名號。

translations.literal: The Chosiakabu chieftain Gongganuo'erbu was granted the title-name "Zunduiguidan."
translations.idiomatic: Chosiakabu chieftain Gongganuo'erbu received the honorific title Zunduiguidan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，溫福奏攻克明郭宗等碉卡。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Wen Fu memorialized the capture of blockhouses including Mingguozong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Wen Fu reported taking Mingguozong blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，阿桂奏攻克美諾碉寨。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, A Gui memorialized the capture of Meinuo stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, A Gui took Meinuo stockade.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，溫福奏彭魯爾等寨番人就撫。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Wen Fu memorialized that fan of Penglu'er and other stockades had come in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Penglu'er stockades submitted to Wen Fu.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，溫福等奏克布朗郭宗、底木達碉寨，澤旺降，僧格桑逃往金川。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Wen Fu and others memorialized the capture of Bulangguozong and Dimuda stockades; Zewang submitted and Senggesang fled to Greater Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Wen Fu took Bulangguozong and Dimuda; Zewang surrendered and Senggesang fled to Greater Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，秦璜以婪贓論斬。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Qin Huang was sentenced to decapitation for covetous corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Qin Huang was condemned to death for graft.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，授薩載江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Sazai was made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Sazai became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，文綬以袒徇褫職，命劉秉恬為四川總督，仍督餉，以富勒渾署之。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Wenshou was stripped of office for favoritism; Liu Bingqian was made Sichuan governor-general while still supervising supplies, with Fulehun acting.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Wenshou fell for favoritism; Liu Bingqian took Sichuan with Fulehun acting.

sentences.zh: 三十八年春正月壬辰，召永德來京，調熊學鵬為廣西巡撫，三寶為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Thirty-eighth year, spring, first month, day renchen: Yongde was summoned to the capital; Xiong Xuepeng was transferred to Guangxi governor and Sanbao to Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year's first month, Yongde was recalled and Xiong Xuepeng and Sanbao were shifted to Guangxi and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 鄂寶仍授山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Ebao was again appointed Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ebao returned as Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 以小金川平，緩四川官兵經過之成都等五十一廳州縣三十八年額賦及分辦夫糧之溫江等九十廳州縣三十七年蠲剩額賦。

translations.literal: Because Lesser Jinchuan was pacified, quota tax for the thirty-eighth year was deferred in fifty-one Sichuan prefectures and counties including Chengdu through which troops passed, and remaining quota tax remitted for the thirty-seventh year in ninety prefectures and counties including Wenjiang that had shared transport labor.
translations.idiomatic: With Lesser Jinchuan pacified, Sichuan tax relief was granted along troop routes and in districts that had borne transport levies.

sentences.zh: 番民賦貢，一體緩之。

translations.literal: Tribute levies on fan were likewise deferred.
translations.idiomatic: Fan tribute payments were deferred as well.

sentences.zh: 溫福等進剿金川，分由喀爾薩爾、喀拉依、綽斯甲布三路進兵。

translations.literal: Wen Fu and others advanced against Greater Jinchuan, dividing forces to march by the Kharsar, Kalayi, and Chosiakabu routes.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu opened the Greater Jinchuan campaign on three routes through Kharsar, Kalayi, and Chosiakabu.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，哈薩克博羅特使臣入覲。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Kazakh envoy Borote came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Kazakh envoy Borote was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 以阿爾泰婪贓，賜自盡。

translations.literal: Because Altai was guilty of covetous corruption, he was granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Altai was ordered to kill himself for graft.

sentences.zh: 戊午，調永貴署戶部尚書，以阿桂為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yonggui was transferred to act as Minister of Revenue; A Gui was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Yonggui acted at Revenue and A Gui became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申朔，諭溫福等檄索諾木擒獻僧格桑。

translations.literal: Second month, first day gengshen: Wen Fu and others were instructed by proclamation to search out and deliver Senggesang bound.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Wen Fu was ordered to seize and hand over Senggesang.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅朔，日食。

translations.literal: Third month, first day gengyin: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the third-month new moon on gengyin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上詣泰陵。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor went to Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor visited Tailing.

sentences.zh: 奉皇太后巡幸天津，免所過地方及天津府屬本年錢糧十分之三。

translations.literal: Accompanying the Empress Dowager, the Emperor toured Tianjin; one-tenth of that year's land tax was remitted for places passed through and for Tianjin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The court toured Tianjin with the Empress Dowager and remitted one-tenth of the year's tax along the route.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上閱永定河堤。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor inspected the Yongding River embankments.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Emperor inspected the Yongding River dikes.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor visited Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor again visited Tailing.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上命簡親王豐訥亨奉皇太后自申昜春園啟鑾，免蹕路所經之宛平等二十州縣及天津府屬各州縣三十三年至三十六年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor ordered Prince Jian Fengneheng to escort the Empress Dowager from Shenyang Spring Garden on her progress, and arrears of registered taxes from the thirty-third through thirty-sixth years were remitted in twenty counties including Wanping along the route and in Tianjin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Fengneheng escorted the Empress Dowager from Shenyang Spring Garden and tax arrears were forgiven along the route.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免直隸三十三年至三十五年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jihai, arrears of registered taxes from the thirty-third through thirty-fifth years were remitted in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Zhili tax arrears from years thirty-three through thirty-five were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上閱淀河。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor inspected the Dian River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor inspected the Dian River.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上奉皇太后駐蹕天津。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, halted the progress at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the court halted at Tianjin with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上奉皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned from progress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the court returned from Tianjin with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 免通州、寶坻等九州縣三十六年逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears of registered taxes for the thirty-sixth year were remitted in nine counties including Tongzhou and Baodi.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-sixth-year tax arrears were forgiven in nine districts including Tongzhou and Baodi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上閱永定河。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor inspected the Yongding River.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the Emperor again inspected the Yongding River.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the court returned to Beijing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 閏三月己巳，以紥拉豐阿為御前大臣。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day jisi: Zhala Feng'a was made an imperial bodyguard grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 3, Zhala Feng'a became an imperial bodyguard minister.

sentences.zh: 命劉統勛等充辦理四庫全書總裁。

translations.literal: Liu Tongxun and others were ordered to serve as chief directors for compiling the Complete Library in Four Sections.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tongxun and others were appointed chief directors of the Siku Quanshu project.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以素爾訥署工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Suernai acted as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Suernai acted as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，以綽克托為烏什參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuxu: Zhuoketuo was made participating minister at Ush.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Zhuoketuo became Ush participating minister.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命索琳以署禮部侍郎在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Suolin was ordered to serve in the Grand Council while acting as Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Suolin joined the Grand Council as acting Rites vice minister.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命慶桂以理藩院侍郎、副都統為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Qinggui was ordered to serve as Yili participating minister as Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Qinggui became Yili participating minister from the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，諭高晉賑清河等州縣及大河、長淮二衛被水災民。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Gao Jin was instructed to relieve flood victims in Qinghe and other districts and in the Dahe and Changhuai guards.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Gao Jin was told to relieve flood victims on the Huai and in Qinghe districts.

sentences.zh: 戊午，加大學士溫福、戶部尚書舒赫德、工部尚書福隆安太子太保，禮部尚書王際華、工部尚書裘曰修太子少傅，禮部尚書阿桂、署兵部尚書豐升額、直隸總督周元理、閩浙總督鍾音、四川總督劉秉恬太子少保。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Grand Secretary Wen Fu, Revenue Minister Shuhede, and Works Minister Fulong'an were advanced to Junior Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Rites Minister Wang Jihua and Works Minister Qiu Yuexiu to Junior Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Rites Minister A Gui, acting War Minister Fengsheng'e, Zhili Governor-General Zhou Yuanli, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Zhong Yin, and Sichuan Governor-General Liu Bingqian to Junior Grand Protector of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Wen Fu, Shuhede, and Fulong'an received heir-apparent mentor ranks and six other ministers received tutor or protector honors.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，工部尚書裘曰修卒，以嵇璜代之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: Works Minister Qiu Yuexiu died and Ji Huang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Qiu Yuexiu died and Ji Huang became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上奉皇太后啟鑾，免經過地方本年錢糧十分之三。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, set out on progress; one-tenth of that year's land tax was remitted for places passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the court left on progress with the Empress Dowager and remitted one-tenth of the year's tax along the route.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上奉皇太后駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, halted the progress at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the court reached the Summer Resort with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，盛京將軍增海卒，調弘晌代之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Shengjing General Zenghai died and Hongshang was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Zenghai died and Hongshang became Shengjing general.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改烏魯木齊參贊大臣為都統，以索諾木策凌為之，仍聽伊犁將軍節制。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Urumqi participating minister was changed to commander-in-chief, with Sonom Celeng appointed while still under the Yili general's command.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Urumqi's post became commander-in-chief under Sonom Celeng and the Yili general.

sentences.zh: 己卯，猛遮土目叭立齋等內附。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Mengzhe chieftain Baliqi and others came within the pale.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Mengzhe chieftain Baliqi and others submitted.

sentences.zh: 癸未，召車布登紥布來京，命拉旺多爾濟署烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Chebudengzhab was summoned to the capital; Lawangduo'erji acted as Uliasutai general.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Chebudengzhab was recalled and Lawangduo'erji acted at Uliasutai.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，阿桂等奏金川番賊陷喇嘛寺糧台，襲據底木達、布朗郭宗。

translations.literal: On day yisi, A Gui and others memorialized that Greater Jinchuan fan rebels had seized the Lama Temple granary depot and overrun Dimuda and Bulangguozong.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, A Gui reported Greater Jinchuan rebels seizing the Lama Temple depot and retaking Dimuda and Bulangguozong.

sentences.zh: 己酉，鄂寶奏金川番賊襲據大板昭。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Ebao memorialized that Greater Jinchuan fan rebels had seized Daban Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Ebao reported rebels taking Daban Zhao.

sentences.zh: 壬子，定邊將軍溫福、四川提督馬全、署貴州提督牛天畀敗績於木果木，俱死之。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Pacification General Wen Fu, Sichuan Provincial Commander Ma Quan, and acting Guizhou Provincial Commander Niu Tianbi were defeated at Muguomu and all died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Wen Fu, Ma Quan, and Niu Tianbi were killed in defeat at Muguomu.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以阿桂為定邊將軍，贈溫福一等伯。

translations.literal: On day guichou, A Gui was made Pacification General for the Border and Wen Fu was posthumously enfeoffed as a first-class earl.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, A Gui became border general and Wen Fu was posthumously made a first-class earl.

sentences.zh: 小金川酋僧格桑父澤旺伏誅。

translations.literal: Zewang, father of Lesser Jinchuan chieftain Senggesang, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Senggesang's father Zewang was put to death.

sentences.zh: 大學士劉綸卒。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Liu Lun died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Liu Lun died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以富勒渾為四川總督，起文綬為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Fulehun was made Sichuan governor-general and Wenshou was reinstated as Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Fulehun took Sichuan and Wenshou returned to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，阿桂奏剿洗小金川番賊，盡毀碉寨，諭嘉之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, A Gui memorialized the suppression of Lesser Jinchuan fan rebels and the destruction of all stockades; the court praised him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, A Gui reported clearing Lesser Jinchuan and destroying its stockades, and was praised.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午朔，召舒赫德來京，以伊勒圖為伊犁將軍，慶桂為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day wuwu: Shuhede was summoned to the capital; Yiletuo was made Yili general and Qinggui Tarbagatai participating minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Shuhede was recalled; Yiletuo became Yili general and Qinggui went to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 己未，金川番賊陷美諾、明郭宗，海蘭察退師日隆。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Greater Jinchuan fan rebels seized Meinuo and Mingguozong; Hailancha withdrew the army to Rilong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, rebels took Meinuo and Mingguozong and Hailancha fell back to Rilong.

sentences.zh: 諭阿桂由章谷退師，豐升額退駐巴拉朗等處。

translations.literal: A Gui was instructed to withdraw the army by Zhanggu; Fengsheng'e withdrew to garrison at Balalang and other places.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui was ordered to pull back through Zhanggu and Fengsheng'e to hold Balalang.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命富德為參贊大臣赴軍營，命阿桂撤噶爾拉之師。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Fude was made participating minister to proceed to the army; A Gui was ordered to withdraw troops from Ga'erla.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Fude went to the front and A Gui was told to lift the Ga'erla column.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命舒赫德為武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Shuhede was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Shuhede became a Wuyingdian grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 調阿桂為戶部尚書，永貴為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: A Gui was transferred to Minister of Revenue and Yonggui to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui became Revenue Minister and Yonggui Rites Minister.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，齊齊哈爾蝗。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, locusts struck Qiqihar.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, locusts hit Qiqihar.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以溫福乖方僨事，革一等伯爵，仍予恤典。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, because Wen Fu had mishandled affairs and ruined the campaign, his first-class earldom was revoked, though funeral honors were still granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Wen Fu lost his earldom for failure but kept funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 褫劉秉恬職。

translations.literal: Liu Bingqian was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bingqian lost his post.

sentences.zh: 命議恤木果木陣亡提督馬全、牛天畀，副都統巴朗、阿爾素納，總兵張大經及各文武員弁。

translations.literal: Orders were issued to deliberate posthumous honors for Provincial Commander Ma Quan and Niu Tianbi, who died at Muguomu, Vice Commanders-in-Chief Balang and A'ersuna, Brigadier Zhang Dajing, and all civil and military officers who fell.
translations.idiomatic: The court was told to fix honors for officers killed at Muguomu, including Ma Quan, Niu Tianbi, Balang, A'ersuna, and Zhang Dajing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，諭阿桂先復小金川，分三路進剿。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, A Gui was instructed first to recover Lesser Jinchuan and then advance against Greater Jinchuan on three routes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, A Gui was ordered to retake Lesser Jinchuan and attack Greater Jinchuan on three routes.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，以阿桂為定西將軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuzi: A Gui was made Pacification General for the West.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, A Gui became western pacification general.

sentences.zh: 命于敏中為文華殿大學士，舒赫德管刑部，劉統勛專管吏部。

translations.literal: Yu Minzhong was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory; Shuhede took charge of Punishments and Liu Tongxun solely of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Minzhong joined the Wenhua Hall; Shuhede took Punishments and Liu Tongxun Personnel alone.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命程景伊協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Cheng Jingyi was ordered to assist as grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Cheng Jingyi was told to assist as grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 調王際華為戶部尚書，蔡新為禮部尚書，嵇璜為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Wang Jihua was transferred to Minister of Revenue, Cai Xin to Minister of Rites, and Ji Huang to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jihua, Cai Xin, and Ji Huang were shifted to Revenue, Rites, and War.

sentences.zh: 以閻循琦為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Yan Xunqi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Xunqi became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以明亮為定邊右副將軍，富德為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Mingliang was made Right Deputy Pacification General for the Border and Fude participating minister.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Mingliang became right deputy border general and Fude coordinating minister.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor went to Mulan for the hunt enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，降海蘭察為領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renxu: Hailancha was demoted to lead commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Hailancha was reduced to lead commander.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor returned to lodge at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Emperor returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上送皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on her return from progress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor saw the Empress Dowager home from her journey.

sentences.zh: 己巳，索諾木挾僧格桑歸大金川，以其兄岡達克往美諾。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Sonam took Senggesang back to Greater Jinchuan and sent his elder brother Gangdake to Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Sonam brought Senggesang to Greater Jinchuan and sent Gangdake to Meinuo.

sentences.zh: 諭阿桂乘機收復。

translations.literal: A Gui was instructed to seize the opportunity to recover lost ground.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui was told to exploit the moment and recover territory.

sentences.zh: 允戶部請開金川軍需捐例。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue's request to open a military-supply sale-of-offices quota for the Jinchuan campaign was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved a Jinchuan military-supply donation quota.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上自避暑山莊迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor returned from progress at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor left the Summer Resort for the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以多敏為科布多參贊大臣，車木楚克紥布為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Duomin was made Kobdo participating minister and Chemuchukezhab Uliasutai participating minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Duomin went to Kobdo and Chemuchukezhab to Uliasutai.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上奉皇太后還京。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor brought the Empress Dowager back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，吏部尚書託庸致仕，調官保為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Tuoyong, Minister of Personnel, retired from office; Guanbao was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Tuoyong retired as personnel minister and Guanbao succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 以英廉為刑部尚書，仍兼管戶部侍郎事。

translations.literal: Yinglian was made Minister of Punishments, still concurrently overseeing Households vice-minister affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglian became minister of punishments while still handling household vice-minister duties.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，和碩諴親王允祕卒。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yisi: Prince Shen of the First Rank died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on yisi day, Prince Shen died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，褫車布登紥布定邊左副將軍職，仍留親王銜，以瑚圖靈阿代之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Chebudengzhabu was stripped of the post of Left Deputy General on Pacifying the Border but kept his princely rank; Hutuling'a replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Chebudengzhabu lost the left deputy border command but kept his prince rank; Hutuling'a replaced him.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，阿桂等奏進剿小金川，攻克資哩山樑等處，收復沃克什官寨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao: A Gui and others memorialized on the advance against Lesser Jinchuan, capturing Zilishan Ridge and other places and recovering the Wokesh official stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, A Gui reported capturing Zilishan Ridge and recovering Wokesh in the Lesser Jinchuan campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命福祿往西寧辦事。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Fulu was ordered to proceed to Xining on business.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Fulu was sent to Xining.

sentences.zh: 召伍彌泰回京。

translations.literal: Wu Mitai was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mitai was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己巳，阿桂等奏克復美諾，命進剿金川。

translations.literal: On day jisi, A Gui and others memorialized recovery of Meinuo; they were ordered to advance on Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, A Gui reported Meinuo recovered and was ordered to press the Jinchuan attack.

sentences.zh: 辛未，軍機大臣、大學士劉統勛卒，上親臨賜奠，贈太傅。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Grand Councilor and Grand Secretary Liu Tongxun died; the Emperor went in person to grant funeral offerings and bestowed the posthumous rank of Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Liu Tongxun died; the Emperor mourned in person and made him Grand Tutor posthumously.

sentences.zh: 壬申，召梁國治來京，在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Liang Guozhi was summoned to the capital to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Liang Guozhi was called to the Grand Council in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 調巴延三為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Bayansan was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Bayansan became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 以畢沅為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Bi Yuan was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Yuan became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，明亮等奏克復僧格宗等碉寨。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Mingliang and others memorialized recovery of Sengezong and other blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Mingliang reported capturing Sengezong and other stockades.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，以彰寶為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guisi: Zhangbao was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Zhangbao became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命李侍堯為武英殿大學士，仍管兩廣總督事。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Li Shiyao was made Wuying Hall Grand Secretary, still supervising Guangdong-Guangxi governor-general affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Li Shiyao became Wuying grand secretary while keeping the Guangdong-Guangxi post.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、安南來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Annam sent tribute.
