translations.idiomatic: That year Korea and Annam presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十九年春正月丙子，以姚立德為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Thirty-ninth year, spring, first month, day bingzi: Yao Lide was made Hedong canal-route commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the thirty-ninth year, Yao Lide became Hedong canal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，阿桂等克贊巴拉克等山樑。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, A Gui and others captured Zanbalake and other mountain ridges.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, A Gui took Zanbalake Ridge and others.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申朔，命豐升額等助阿桂進攻勒烏圍。

translations.literal: Second month, first day jiashen, new moon: Feng Sheng'e and others were ordered to assist A Gui in attacking Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: At the second-month new moon, Feng Sheng'e was ordered to help A Gui attack Lewuwei.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，明亮等奏克木谿等山樑。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Mingliang and others memorialized capture of Muxi and other mountain ridges.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Mingliang reported taking Muxi Ridge and others.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，豐升額等克莫爾敏山樑。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Feng Sheng'e and others captured Moermin Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Feng Sheng'e took Moermin Ridge.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，蠲江蘇山陽等十州縣衛三十八年水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day yisi, graded remissions of quota land tax were granted for the thirty-eighth-year flood disaster in ten Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, graded flood tax relief reached ten Jiangsu districts including Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上詣東陵，並巡幸盤山。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor went to the Eastern Tombs and also toured Pan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the court visited the Eastern Tombs and Pan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵，至孝賢皇后陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, he paid rites at Zhaoxi, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling, and offered wine at Empress Xiaoxian's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs and offered wine at Empress Xiaoxian's grave.

sentences.zh: 臨故大學士公傅恆塋賜奠。

translations.literal: He visited the grave of the late Grand Secretary Fu Heng and granted funeral offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor mourned at Fu Heng's tomb and sent offerings.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上駐蹕盤山。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor halted at Pan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the court halted at Pan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，阿桂等克羅博瓦山樑，加阿桂太子太保，以海蘭察為內大臣，額森特為散秩大臣。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengshen: A Gui and others captured Luobowa Ridge; A Gui was advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Hailancha was made inner grand minister; Esente was made grand minister without specific rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, A Gui took Luobowa Ridge, became heir-apparent grand guardian, and Hailancha and Esente received high honors.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 辛未，阿桂等克得斯東寨。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, A Gui and others captured Desidong Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, A Gui took Desidong Stockade.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，明亮等克喀咱普等處，上嘉賚之。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Mingliang and others captured Kazapu and other places; the Emperor praised and rewarded them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Mingliang captured Kazapu and others and received imperial praise.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，順天大興等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiyou: locusts in Shuntian, Daxing, and other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, locusts struck Shuntian, Daxing, and nearby counties.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以京師及近畿地方旱，命刑部清理庶獄，減軍流以下罪，直隸如之。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, because the capital and nearby home counties were drought-stricken, the Ministry of Punishments was ordered to clear routine prisons and reduce punishments for exile with forced labor and below; Zhili followed likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, drought led to prison review and sentence reductions in the capital and Zhili.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以御史李漱芳劾福隆安家人滋事，上嘉之，予敘。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, because Censor Li Shufang impeached Fulung'an's household staff for causing trouble, the Emperor praised him and granted a merit review.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Li Shufang was commended for impeaching Fulung'an's servants.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑朔，命刑部減秋審、朝審緩決一二次以上罪。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day guichou, new moon: the Ministry of Punishments was ordered to reduce autumn and palace assize sentences delayed once or twice.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth-month new moon, delayed assize sentences were ordered reduced.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，彰寶以病解任，以圖思德署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Zhangbao resigned on account of illness; Tuside took charge as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Zhangbao resigned ill and Tuside acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the court took the Empress Dowager on the Mulan autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上奉皇太后駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, halted at the Mountain Resort for Summer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the court halted with the Empress Dowager at the summer resort.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，阿桂等奏克穆爾渾圖碉卡。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: A Gui and others memorialized capture of Mu'erhuntu blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, A Gui reported taking Mu'erhuntu blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，阿桂等克色淜普山碉卡。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiayin: A Gui and others captured Sekunpu mountain blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, A Gui took Sekunpu mountain blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 己未，阿桂等克喇穆喇穆山等碉卡。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, A Gui and others captured Lamulamu mountain and other blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, A Gui took Lamulamu and other mountain blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，阿桂等克日則雅口等處寺碉。

translations.literal: On day renxu, A Gui and others captured Rizeyakou and other monastery blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, A Gui took Rizeyakou monastery blockhouses and others.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，烏魯木齊額魯特部蝗。

translations.literal: On day yichou, locusts among the Oirat of Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, locusts struck the Oirat at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 庚午，明亮等克達爾圖山樑碉卡。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Mingliang and others captured Da'ertu mountain ridge blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Mingliang took Da'ertu ridge blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以于敏中未奏太監高雲從囑託公事，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, because Yu Minzhong had not memorialized on the eunuch Gao Yuncong's request regarding official business, the ministry was ordered to deliberate severely.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Yu Minzhong was referred for severe review for concealing Gao Yuncong's request.

sentences.zh: 以阿思哈為左都御史。

translations.literal: Asiha was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Asiha became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命阿思哈在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Asiha was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Asiha entered the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 太監高雲從處斬。

translations.literal: The eunuch Gao Yuncong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yuncong was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，阿桂等克格魯瓦覺等處碉寨。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, A Gui and others captured Geluwajue and other blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, A Gui took Geluwajue stockades and others.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午朔，日食。

translations.literal: Eighth month, first day renwu, new moon: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the eighth-month new moon on renwu there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，富德等克穆當噶爾、羊圈等處碉卡。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Fude and others captured Mudanggar, Yangquan, and other blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Fude took Mudanggar, Yangquan, and other blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor went on the Mulan hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金川頭人綽窩斯甲降，獻賊目僧格桑屍。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Jinchuan chieftain Zhuowosijia submitted and presented the corpse of the rebel leader Senggesang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Zhuowosijia surrendered and sent Senggesang's corpse.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，山東壽張縣奸民王倫等謀逆，命山東巡撫徐績剿捕之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yimao: in Shouzhang county, Shandong, the traitor Wang Lun and others plotted rebellion; Shandong governor Xu Ji was ordered to suppress and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Wang Lun plotted rebellion in Shouzhang and Xu Ji was ordered to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命大學士舒赫德赴江南，同高晉塞決口。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Grand Secretary Shuhede was ordered to proceed to Jiangnan with Gao Jin to block the breach.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Shuhede was sent to Jiangnan with Gao Jin to close the breach.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor returned to halt at the Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Emperor returned to the summer resort.

sentences.zh: 命舒赫德先赴山東剿捕王倫。

translations.literal: Shuhede was ordered first to proceed to Shandong to suppress and capture Wang Lun.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede was told to go first to Shandong against Wang Lun.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命額駙拉旺多爾濟、左都御史阿思哈帶侍衛章京及健銳、火器二營兵，往山東會剿王倫。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Imperial Son-in-law Lawangdorji, Left Censor-in-Chief Asiha, bodyguards and secretaries, and troops of the Vanguard and Firearms Corps were ordered to proceed to Shandong to join in suppressing Wang Lun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Lawangdorji, Asiha, and Vanguard and Firearms troops were sent to join the hunt for Wang Lun.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，王倫圍臨清，屯閘口。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Wang Lun besieged Linqing and encamped at Zha Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Wang Lun besieged Linqing and held Zha Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上送皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on her return journey.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager homeward.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以天津府七縣旱，命撥通倉米十萬石備賑。

translations.literal: On day guihai, because seven counties of Tianjin prefecture were drought-stricken, 100,000 shi of grain from Tongcang was ordered disbursed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, drought in seven Tianjin counties brought 100,000 shi of Tongcang grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上自避暑山莊迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor returned from the Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Emperor returned from the summer resort.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，山東兗州鎮總兵惟一、德州城守尉格圖肯以臨陣退避，處斬。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Shandong Yanzhou garrison commander Weiyi and Dezou city garrison commandant Getuken were executed for retreating in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Weiyi and Getuken were executed for fleeing in battle.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以江蘇山陽等四縣水災，命免明年額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, because four Jiangsu counties including Shanyang suffered flood disaster, next year's quota tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, next year's tax was remitted in four flooded Jiangsu counties including Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the court brought the Empress Dowager back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，山東臨清賊平，王倫自焚死。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Linqing rebels in Shandong were pacified; Wang Lun burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Linqing rebels were crushed and Wang Lun burned himself.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳朔，以楊景素為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day xinsi, new moon: Yang Jingsu was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: At the tenth-month new moon, Yang Jingsu became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免臨清新城本年未完額賦，並舊城未完額賦十分之五。

translations.literal: On day renchen, this year's outstanding quota tax for Linqing New City was remitted, and five-tenths of outstanding tax for the Old City.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Linqing New City tax was waived and half the Old City arrears remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以徐績為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Xu Ji was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Xu Ji became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，明亮等克日旁等碉寨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: Mingliang and others captured Ripang and other blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Mingliang took Ripang stockades and others.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以舒赫德為御前大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Shuhede was made Imperial Front Grand Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Shuhede became an imperial front grand minister.

sentences.zh: 阿桂等克日爾巴當噶碉寨。

translations.literal: A Gui and others captured Rierbadangga blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui took Rierbadangga stockades.

sentences.zh: 以阿桂為御前大臣，海蘭察為御前侍衛。

translations.literal: A Gui was made Imperial Front Grand Minister and Hailancha an Imperial Front guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui became an imperial front grand minister and Hailancha an imperial front guard.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以四川成都等一百四十府廳州縣行軍運糧，免歷年額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, because one hundred forty Sichuan prefectures, departments, and counties including Chengdu transported army grain, prior years' quota tax was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, graded tax relief was granted to 140 Sichuan districts supplying the army.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，阿桂克格魯古丫口等處碉寨。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, A Gui captured Geluguyakou and other blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, A Gui took Geluguyakou stockades and others.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十年春正月甲戌，阿桂等克康爾薩山樑。

translations.literal: Fortieth year, spring, first month, day jiaxu: A Gui and others captured Kang'ersa Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fortieth year, A Gui took Kang'ersa Ridge.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，阿桂等克甲爾納等處碉寨。

translations.literal: Second month, day jimao: A Gui and others captured Jia'erna and other blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, A Gui took Jia'erna stockades and others.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，阿桂克斯莫思達碉寨。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, A Gui captured Simosi blockhouse stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, A Gui took Simosi stockade.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以李瀚為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Li Han was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Li Han became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，上幸盤山。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinhai: the Emperor visited Pan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor visited Pan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上駐蹕盤山。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor halted at Pan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the court halted at Pan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 蠲江南句容等十九州縣，淮安、大河二衛三十九年水旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota land tax for thirty-ninth-year flood and drought disaster in nineteen Jiangnan prefectures and counties including Jurong, and Huai'an and Dahe guards, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Flood and drought tax was remitted in nineteen Jiangnan districts and two guards including Jurong.

sentences.zh: 壬申，蠲長蘆屬滄州等六州縣、嚴鎮等六場，河南信陽等五州縣三十五年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renshen, prior-year drought quota tax was remitted for six Changlu districts including Cangzhou and six saltern fields including Yanzhen, and five Henan prefectures and counties including Xinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, drought tax was remitted in Changlu, saltern, and Henan districts including Cangzhou and Xinyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅朔，蠲安徽合肥等十四州縣、廬州等四衛三十九年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day wuyin, new moon: thirty-ninth-year drought quota tax was remitted in fourteen Anhui prefectures and counties including Hefei and four guards including Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the fourth-month new moon, drought tax was remitted in fourteen Anhui counties and four guards including Hefei.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，四川軍營參贊大臣、領侍衛內大臣、和碩親王、固倫額駙色布騰巴勒珠爾卒。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Sichuan army commissioner, lead palace guards grand minister, Prince of the First Rank, and Imperial Son-in-law Sebten Balzhur died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Prince and commissioner Sebten Balzhur died in the Sichuan camp.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命明山為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Mingshan was ordered to proceed as Uliastai commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Mingshan was sent as Uliastai commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賜吳錫齡等一百五十八人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day renyin, one hundred fifty-eight metropolitan graduates including Wu Xilin were granted jinshi degrees and origin ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Wu Xilin and 157 others received jinshi degrees with graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，阿桂等克木思工噶克丫口等處城碉。

translations.literal: On day guimao, A Gui and others captured Musigongyakou and other city blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, A Gui took Musigongyakou city blockhouses and others.

sentences.zh: 明亮等克甲索、宜喜。

translations.literal: Mingliang and others captured Jiasuo and Yixi.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang took Jiasuo and Yixi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，明亮等克達爾圖等處碉寨。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Mingliang and others captured Da'ertu and other blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Mingliang took Da'ertu stockades and others.

sentences.zh: 以明亮、福康安為內大臣。

translations.literal: Mingliang and Fu Kang'an were made inner grand ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang and Fu Kang'an became inner grand ministers.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉，蠲直隸霸州、保定等三十九州縣三十九年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiyou: thirty-ninth-year drought quota tax was remitted in thirty-nine Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou and Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, drought tax was remitted in thirty-nine Zhili districts including Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，阿桂等奏克巴木通等處碉卡。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, A Gui and others memorialized capture of Bamutong and other blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, A Gui reported taking Bamutong blockhouses and others.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，明亮奏克茹寨、甲索等處碉卡。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Mingliang memorialized capture of Ru Stockade, Jiasuo, and other blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Mingliang reported taking Ru Stockade, Jiasuo, and others.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，阿桂等奏克噶爾丹等碉寨。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, A Gui and others memorialized capture of Ga'erdan and other blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, A Gui reported taking Ga'erdan stockades and others.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上幸木蘭，奉皇太后駐湯山行宮。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor went to Mulan; the Empress Dowager halted at the Tangshan Traveling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan while the Empress Dowager stayed at Tangshan.

sentences.zh: 明亮等奏克巴舍什等處碉寨。

translations.literal: Mingliang and others memorialized capture of Basheshi and other blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang reported taking Basheshi stockades and others.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，阿桂等奏克遜克爾宗等處碉寨。

translations.literal: On day yihai, A Gui and others memorialized capture of Xunke'erzong and other blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, A Gui reported taking Xunke'erzong stockades and others.

sentences.zh: 加封定邊右副將軍、果毅公豐升額為果毅繼勇公。

translations.literal: Feng Sheng'e, Pacification Deputy General on the Right of the Border and Duke of Guoyi, was advanced to Duke of Guoyi, Successor in Valor.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Sheng'e, border deputy general and Duke of Guoyi, was raised to Duke of Guoyi, Successor in Valor.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑朔，蠲湖北漢陽等十五州縣、武昌等六衛一所三十九年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day dingchou: quota land tax from the thirty-ninth year's drought was remitted for fifteen prefectures and counties including Hanyang in Hubei and six guards and one post including Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: At the sixth-month new moon, thirty-ninth-year drought taxes were remitted in Hubei districts including Hanyang and Wuchang guard units.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上詣廣仁嶺萬壽亭迎皇太后駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor went to Wanshou Pavilion at Guangren Ridge to welcome the Empress Dowager to halt at the Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor welcomed the Empress Dowager to the Summer Resort at Wanshou Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以豐升額為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Feng Sheng'e was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Feng Sheng'e became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 丙申，領隊大臣額爾特褫職逮治。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, expedition leader E'erte was stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, expedition leader E'erte was dismissed and taken into custody.

sentences.zh: 庚子，設管理烏魯木齊額魯特部落領隊大臣，以全簡為之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, a post of expedition leader managing Oirat tribes at Urumqi was established, with Quanjian appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Quanjian became expedition leader over Oirat tribes at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，阿桂等奏攻克昆色爾等處山樑碉寨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renxu: Agui and others memorialized the capture of mountain-ridge blockhouses and forts at Kunse'er and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Agui reported taking Kunse'er ridge forts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，阿桂等克章噶等碉寨。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Agui and others captured blockhouse forts at Zhangga and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Agui took Zhangga blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 額洛木寨頭人革什甲木參等率眾來降。

translations.literal: Geshiamucan, headman of E'luomu stockade, and others led their people to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: E'luomu headman Geshiamucan and others surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚午，蠲甘肅皋蘭等七廳州縣三十九年被水被旱額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, quota land tax from the thirty-ninth year's flood and drought was remitted for seven departments and counties including Gaolan in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, thirty-ninth-year flood and drought taxes were remitted in seven Gansu districts including Gaolan.

sentences.zh: 阿桂等克直古腦一帶碉寨。

translations.literal: Agui and others captured blockhouse forts along Zhigunao.
translations.idiomatic: Agui took Zhigunao blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子朔，日食。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day bingzi: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the eighth-month new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，阿桂等克隆斯得寨。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Agui and others captured Longside stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Agui took Longside stockade.

sentences.zh: 明亮等克紥烏古山樑。

translations.literal: Mingliang and others captured the mountain ridge at Zhawugu.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang seized the Zhawugu ridge.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以霸州等三十餘州縣被水，撥直隸藩庫銀五十萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, because more than thirty prefectures and counties including Bazhou were flooded, five hundred thousand taels from the Zhili treasury were allocated for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, five hundred thousand taels were sent to flood-stricken Zhili districts including Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor went to Mulan for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，阿桂等奏克勒烏圍之捷，進剿噶喇依賊寨。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Agui and others memorialized victory at Lewei and an advance against the rebel stockade at Garzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Agui reported victory at Lewei and pressed Garzhi.

sentences.zh: 上命優敘將軍阿桂，副將軍豐升額，參贊大臣海蘭察、額森特等功。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered preferential recognition of the achievements of General Agui, Deputy General Feng Sheng'e, and participating ministers Hai Lancha and Esente.
translations.idiomatic: The court honored Agui, Feng Sheng'e, Hai Lancha, and Esente for their service.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，召舒赫德赴熱河行在。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Shuhede was summoned to the traveling court at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Shuhede was called to the Rehe traveling court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，封羅卜藏錫喇布為貝子。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Lobzang Silebu was enfeoffed as beile.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Lobzang Silebu received the rank of beile.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命侍郎袁守侗等赴貴州，讞知府蘇墧稟揭總督、藩、臬袒護同知席纘一案。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Vice Ministers Yuan Shoutong and others were ordered to Guizhou to try the case of prefect Su Shan's memorial accusing the governor-general, provincial treasurer, and provincial judge of shielding subprefect Xi Zuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Yuan Shoutong and others were sent to try Su Shan's charges against Guizhou officials who shielded Xi Zuan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，蠲湖北鍾祥等十二州縣並武昌等七衛三十九年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu: quota land tax from the thirty-ninth year's drought was remitted for twelve prefectures and counties including Zhongxiang in Hubei and seven guards including Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, thirty-ninth-year drought taxes were remitted in Hubei districts including Zhongxiang and Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor returned to halt at the Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上送皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on her return journey.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager homeward.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以圖思德劾蘇墧浮收勒索，命袁守侗等嚴鞫之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, because Tusi De impeached Su Shan for extorting levies beyond tax quotas, Yuan Shoutong and others were ordered to try him strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yuan Shoutong and others were ordered to try Su Shan rigorously after Tusi De's impeachment.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以明亮請赴西路失機，嚴斥之，仍奪廣州將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, because Mingliang had requested to go to the western route and missed his opportunity, he was severely rebuked and again stripped of the Guangzhou generalship.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Mingliang was rebuked and again lost the Guangzhou generalship for bungling the western route.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the court returned to Beijing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 阿桂等克當噶克底等處碉寨。

translations.literal: Agui and others captured blockhouse forts at Danggakdi and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Agui took Danggakdi blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，召駐藏辦事伍彌泰，以留保住代之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jimao: Wu Mitai, stationed in Tibet on affairs, was recalled; Liubao Zhu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Wu Mitai left Tibet and Liubao Zhu took his post.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以霸州等六州縣被災較重，命即於閏十月放賑。

translations.literal: On day jichou, because six prefectures and counties including Bazhou had suffered heavier disaster, orders were given to distribute relief in the intercalary tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, intercalary-tenth-month relief was ordered for six flood-hit districts including Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，蠲甘肅皋蘭等十七州縣廳水雹霜災額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, quota land tax was remitted for seventeen prefectures, counties, and departments including Gaolan in Gansu on account of flood, hail, and frost disasters.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, flood, hail, and frost taxes were remitted in seventeen Gansu districts including Gaolan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙申，調裴宗錫為貴州巡撫，命袁守侗暫署，圖思德署雲南巡撫，李質穎為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Pei Zongxi was transferred to Guizhou governor; Yuan Shoutong was ordered to act in that post; Tusi De acted Yunnan governor; Li Zhiying was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Pei Zongxi, Yuan Shoutong, Tusi De, and Li Zhiying received new governorships.

sentences.zh: 閏十月壬子，蘇墧以侵稅誣訐，處斬。

translations.literal: Intercalary tenth month, day renzi: Su Shan was executed for embezzling tax and making false accusations.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month, Su Shan was executed for tax fraud and false charges.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，明亮等奏克紥烏古山樑。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Mingliang and others memorialized the capture of the mountain ridge at Zhawugu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Mingliang reported taking the Zhawugu ridge.

sentences.zh: 甲子，阿桂等奏克西里山黃草坪等處碉卡，總兵曹順死之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Agui and others memorialized capturing blockhouses and posts at Xili Mountain Huangcaoping and elsewhere; Major Cao Shun died in action.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Agui reported Huangcaoping forts taken; Cao Shun was killed.

sentences.zh: 命袁守侗赴四川，同阿揚阿讞冀國勛一案。

translations.literal: Yuan Shoutong was ordered to Sichuan to try the case of Ji Guoxun together with Ayang'a.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shoutong went to Sichuan with Ayang'a to try Ji Guoxun.

sentences.zh: 復封慶恆為克勤郡王。

translations.literal: Qing Heng was again enfeoffed as Prince Keqin of the Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Heng was restored as Prince Keqin of the Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬申，明亮等克耳得谷寨。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Mingliang and others captured Erdegu stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Mingliang took Erdegu stockade.

sentences.zh: 十一月，明亮等克甲索諸處碉卡。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Mingliang and others captured blockhouses and posts at Jiasuo and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Mingliang took Jiasuo blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，福祿以立塔爾一案未能鞫實，革，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Fulu was dismissed and exiled to Yili because he had failed to establish the facts in the Lita'er case.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Fulu was banished to Yili for failing to try the Lita'er case properly.

sentences.zh: 己丑，阿桂克西里第二山峰，並進圍鴉瑪朋寨落。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Agui captured the second peak of Xili Mountain and advanced to besiege Yamabeng stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Agui took Xili's second peak and besieged Yamabeng.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，明亮等奏攻得克爾甲爾古等處碉卡。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Mingliang and others memorialized capturing blockhouses and posts at Ke'erjia'ergu and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Mingliang reported Ke'erjia'ergu forts taken.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，阿桂等奏克舍勒固租魯、科思果木、阿爾古等處碉寨。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Agui and others memorialized capturing blockhouses and stockades at Sheleguzu, Kesiguomu, A'ergu, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Agui reported forts taken at Sheleguzu, Kesiguomu, and A'ergu.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰朔，日食。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day jiachen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the twelfth-month new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁未，工部尚書閻循琦卒，調嵇璜為工部尚書，蔡新為兵部尚書，以曹秀先為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Works Minister Yan Xunqi died; Ji Huang was transferred to Works Minister, Cai Xin to War Minister, and Cao Xiuxian to Rites Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Yan Xunqi died; Ji Huang, Cai Xin, and Cao Xiuxian received ministerial posts.

sentences.zh: 阿桂等克薩爾歪等寨落。

translations.literal: Agui and others captured stockades at Sa'erwai and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Agui took Sa'erwai stockades.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以阿桂為鑲黃旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Agui was made Inner Grand Minister of the Attendant Guard of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Agui became an inner grand minister of the Bordered Yellow Banner guard.

sentences.zh: 調熊學鵬為廣東巡撫，以吳虎炳為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Xiong Xuepeng was transferred to Guangdong governor and Wu Hubing was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Xuepeng and Wu Hubing received Guangdong and Guangxi governorships.

sentences.zh: 甲子，明亮等由達撒谷進兵，連克險要山樑及沿河格爾則寨落。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Mingliang and others advanced from Dasagu, in succession capturing perilous mountain ridges and stockades along the river at Ge'erze.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Mingliang advanced from Dasagu and took Ge'erze river stockades.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，阿桂等克格隆古等處寨落。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Agui and others captured stockades at Gelonggu and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Agui took Gelonggu stockades.

sentences.zh: 庚午，阿桂等由索隆古進據噶佔山梁，直搗噶喇依。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Agui and others advanced from Suolonggu and took position on the Garzhan mountain ridge, thrusting straight at Garzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Agui moved from Suolonggu onto Garzhan ridge toward Garzhi.

sentences.zh: 其頭人色木里雍中及布籠普阿納木來降。

translations.literal: Headmen Semli Yongzhong and Bulongpu Anamu came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Semli Yongzhong and Bulongpu Anamu surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬申，明亮等克甲雜等隘口，並後路巴布里、日蓋古洛，進抵獨松隘口，剋日會搗噶喇依。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Mingliang and others captured passes at Jiaza and elsewhere, and on the rear route Babuli and Rigaiguluo, advancing to Dusong Pass; a date was set to join in storming Garzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Mingliang took Jiaza passes and reached Dusong, planning a joint assault on Garzhi.

sentences.zh: 其頭人達固拉得爾瓦等來降。

translations.literal: Headmen Dagulade'erwa and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Dagulade'erwa and other headmen surrendered.
